name: Abbas Mirza
bio: Abbas Mirza is an experienced Business Consultant with the TCS Cloud Strategy and Transformation team guiding clients to accelerate value from their cloud transformation initiatives. His areas of expertise are cloud and digital strategy, data governance, and enterprise transformation.

name: Abhay Shankar Prasad
designation: Senior Consultant
bio: Abhay Shankar Prasadis a Senior Consultant at TCS and is responsible for tracking industry trends, managing innovation ecosystem, assisting in driving thought leadership, and driving innovation through technology in Life Sciences. With over 21 years of experience in technology and business transformation, he assists various life sciences customers in their transformation journey by adopting new technologies and processes across the business value chain. Abhay holds a post graduate degree in marketing and international business and is an alumnus of the National Institute of Technology, Rourkela, India.

name: Abhijeet Mahankal
bio: Abhijeet has embarked on his four-year journey with TCS through CodeVita, fostering digital transformation through learning and sharing contextual knowledge. From being a trainee to evolving as Technical Lead, he strongly believes that all goals can be met with success if there is unbridled passion and continual upskilling.

name: Abhinav Darbari
bio: Abhinav is a Digital Business Consultant for the Europe & Japan Manufacturing Industry Advisory practice (ITG). He has around 10 years of industrial and consulting experience of working with global clients across Electrical / Electronics, Automotive, Power, Aero, and IT industries. In his current role, he helps clients formulate digital strategy and transformation roadmap leveraging consulting frameworks /tools. Additionally, he likes to play with emerging technologies such as ML and IoT, and is associated with several DIY projects. He is a mechanical engineer and a management graduate from Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Kolkata.

name: Abhirami Murthi
designation: Consulting Partner, BFSI, TCS
bio: Abhirami Murthi is a consulting partner in TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. A TMMi-certified test consultant, Abhirami is an expert in quality engineering (QE) strategy definition, analyzing industry trends, and designing solutions for clients. She has over 18 years of experience in testing advisory and consulting in the digital transformation space. She has also contributed to building IP frameworks in QE and delivered transformation programs for several large banking clients. She holds a master’s degree in software engineering from Bharathiar University, Coimbatore, India.

name: Adam Boostrom
designation: Business Consultant, Consulting, TCS
bio: Adam Boostrom is a consultant, author, futurist, and unashamed lover of artificial intelligence. Through keynote addresses and foresight workshops, he partners with clients to reimagine the business scenarios of tomorrow. After earning degrees from the University of Chicago School of Economics, and the UC Berkeley Haas School of Business, Adam moved to New York, where he writes white papers and science fiction novels in his free time. His first work, Athena’s Choice, was an award-winning bestseller about a future without men. More recently, Adam has discovered an unrecognized talent for bar trivia.

name: Adrian Segens
designation: Sustainability Advisor, Data and Analytics, TCS
bio: Adrian is dedicated to finding innovative methods and technologies to enable businesses to operate more sustainably. He has worked with fast-growing tech companies to address global issues such as supply chain visibility, the transition to a circular economy and placemaking, and has been involved in some of the most innovative sustainability programs in recent times. He is a passionate advocate of lifecycle thinking and whole value chain approach to achieve sustainable business models. At TCS, he works with companies to gain deep insights into their environmental impacts and creates a viable transition to sustainable business.

name: Agnetta Rebecca Ruskin
bio: Agnetta Ruskin is the GTM Lead for TCS TwinX, an enterprise digital twin platform which is a unique combination of artificial intelligence and TCS’ research-based simulation technologies. She spearheads the platform’s publishing and media industry initiatives, responsible for concept-to-market activities. Ruskin has five years of experience in innovative solution prototyping, sales and marketing, product management, client consulting, and business analysis leadership for AI solution implementations. She has worked with various customers across the globe (predominantly in telecom and media industries), towards realizing business objectives such as product or customer lifecycle value maximization, product go-to-market optimization, operational efficiencies, and revenue assurance through fraud prediction and control. Ruskin is an electronics and communications engineer with a master’s degree in international business.

name: Agniv Chakraborty
designation: Data Quality Analyst
bio: Agniv is a Data Quality Analyst with comprehensive expertise in building Data Quality Dashboard's. He is responsible for ensuring pre-built data quality in customer solutions and internal assets.

name: Ajay Chandra
bio: Ajay is a Senior Consulting Partner with TCS’ Communications, Media, and Information Services (CMI) business unit. He is a part of the video and content services business group with expertise in strategizing, conceiving, and delivering business and IT solutions to support TCS’ clients in their transformation journeys in media and broadcasting areas.

name: Ajay Katara
designation: Domain Consultant, Risk Management Practice, Banking and Financial Services, TCS
bio: Ajay Katara is a Domain Consultant with the Risk Management practice in the Banking and Financial Services (BFS) unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He has over 11 years of experience in offering consulting services and implementing solutions, and has worked with several financial enterprises across geographies. Katara has significantly contributed to the conceptualization of strategic offerings in the risk management space in the areas of Basel II, Basel III, CCAR, LCR, and credit risk management. He has a Post-graduation Diploma in Management, specializing in Finance.

name: Ajay Panditrao
designation: Consulting Partner, TCS
bio: Ajay is a Consulting Partner in Cloud Strategy and Transformation practice at TCS. He has over 25 years of experience and strong expertise in user experience-driven digital platform transformations. In his current role, he is responsible for orchestrating digital transformation solutions with focus on developing strategy for futuristic personalization solutions. He has worked with multiple customers to conceptualize, orchestrate, and integrate services in digital transformation programs with the right strategy, research, solution, and value proposition.

name: Ajit Talgaonkar
designation: Managing partner, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Ajit is a managing partner and a supply chain lead in TCS’ Manufacturing business. He has more than 25 years of experience in the manufacturing domain, specifically in supply chain strategy, operations, and technology. Ajit’s consulting experience includes focus on logistics and transportation, smart warehousing, sustainability and 3PL operations. In his current role, he advises customers on advanced planning and execution strategy and digital transformations. He has bachelor’s degree in production engineering from Mumbai University, India and a Master of Science in industrial engineering and management from Oklahoma State University, USA.

name: Akhilesh Kumar Tiwary
designation: Chief Architect, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance at TCS
bio: Akhilesh is a chief architect in TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He has over 25 years of experience in developing and designing large data intensive platforms for BFSI clients and leading teams in large organizations and managing enterprise portfolios. His focus areas include using OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes and Odyssey Jenkins DevOps technologies to modernize legacy products for a cloud-ready data platform.

name: Akhilesh Tiwari
designation: President, Communications, Media and Information Services, TCS
bio: As the Business Group Head of Communications, Media and Information Services (CMI) at TCS, Akhilesh helps TCS customers create rapid value from their technology investments and realize their strategic vision. He oversees the strategy and growth of the TCS’s CMI business partnering with our clients so that they can leverage the next wave of technology change to promote their strategic objectives. With over 25 years of international and multi-faceted leadership experience, Akhilesh focuses on identifying strategic opportunities to build and grow TCS business and drive key strategic initiatives. He has served as a business advisor and innovation enabler for some of the world’s renowned companies. Under his leadership, TCS has received several partner awards and leadership rankings from leading industry analysts. Akhilesh has an Executive Master’s in Business Administration from MIT Sloan School of Management and a Master’s in Materials Technology from the Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay. Connect with Akhilesh on LinkedIn and Twitter .

name: Akshya Kumar Saxena
designation: Domain consultant, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Akshya is a domain consultant in TCS’ manufacturing business. He has more than two decades of experience in strategy, project management and delivery of IoT, and AI/ML-led smart manufacturing and digital supply chain transformations for customers. Akshya currently advises customers on business transformation, innovation in emerging areas, and development of new business models. He is a certified practitioner in design thinking and organizational change management. He has a bachelor’s degree in computer science and engineering from the Coorg Institute of Technology, Karnataka, India.

name: Alakh Kumar Srivastava
designation: Global product manager, IoT and Digital Engineering, TCS
bio: Alakh is a global product manager for the intelligent power plant practice of IOT & Digital Engineering unit at TCS. Alakh brings more than 18 years of professional experience in digital transformation of the power generation industry. He has expertise in operations, maintenance, process improvement, asset performance management, and energy management of combined cycle and coal-based thermal power plants. Alakh has successfully delivered various performance optimization and asset condition monitoring projects, supporting organizations to transition from fossil-based to renewable energy generation systems. He is a mechanical engineer by training and completed his MBA from IIM Kolkata.

name: Alasdair Richardson
designation: ESG Research Analyst, BFSI, TCS
bio: Alasdair works as a Sustainability and ESG Research Analyst for the Sustainable Banking and Finance team within TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance unit. He has expertise in physical climate change and how a changing climate leads to enhanced risks for financial institutions, wider society, and the earth’s natural systems. He has also worked on carbon footprint and financed emissions calculations for financial institutions

name: Alejandra Guerchicoff
designation: Head Industry Leader, TCS ADD™ Safety
bio: Dr. Alejandra Guerchicoff is a PhD in molecular genetics with a post-doctoral training in molecular cardiology. She is working as an Industry Advisor for TCS ADD platform with the Life Sciences unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). Dr. Guerchicoff possesses a rich experience of more than 20 years in the domain of clinical research and post-marketing pharmacovigilance, for medical devices, drugs, combination products, gene and cell therapy, and software as medical device products. She has authored many prestigious journal publications and books on diverse subjects and different therapeutic areas. In her current role, Dr. Alejandra Guerchicoff is working for the development of innovative technology solutions with use of artificial intelligence and other modern technologies across various life sciences operations. Email ID : a.guerchicoff@tcs.com

name: Alison Schambach
bio: Alison has over 25 years of experience in healthcare management. Alison's experience bridges health plan, provider, and pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) operations together with next-generation technology, to help clients achieve cost reductions while addressing the need for quality care. Currently, she manages TCS’ healthcare analytics product, which is focused on value-based care.

name: Alistair Davidson
designation: Senior Content Strategist, TCS Interactive
bio: Alistair Davidson is strategist and author of six books on strategy and technology. He has developed more than 20 software products, including four AI products (strategy, finance, innovation, and innovation funnels). He has been CEO of four companies and is an agile enthusiast. He has facilitated numerous planning sessions and has taught strategy, international strategy, and innovation in four countries. He believes that the Internet increases the need to act on behalf of customers as a core strategy. He has an undergraduate degree and an MBA from Harvard.

name: Almar Latour
designation: Publisher, The Wall Street Journal, CEO, Dow Jones
bio: Almar Latour is a journalist-turned-business leader, combining a passion for news and technology with rich global experience and an entrepreneurial drive. Under his leadership, Dow Jones has doubled digital subscriptions and achieved record profits and revenue, while safeguarding the Wall Street Journal’s reputation as one of the world’s most trusted news organizations.

name: Aloke Mitra
bio: Aloke Mitra heads the customer transformation business for Utilities at TCS. In his current role, he focuses on business transformation initiatives in customer billing, CIS, CRM/CX, customer analytics, and driving new business models. He leads transformation initiatives with top products such as SAP, Salesforce, Dynamics 365, Pega, etc., and focuses on next-gen capabilities with analytics, experience, and automation. Aloke brings in more than 27 years of wide-ranging experience in business consulting, strategy and architecture, and technology transformation globally, across North America, UK, Europe, and ANZ. He has been part of customer engagements and pursuits in the Energy and Utilities, Natural Resources, Manufacturing, and Public Sector industries. He has also led business advisory practice, solution engineering, product and asset development, and industry thought leadership. Aloke holds a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from IIT Kharagpur and an MBA in Finance from the Faculty of Management Studies, Delhi.

name: Alok Vyas
designation: Business transformation and supply chain management consultant, Retail, TCS
bio: Alok Vyas has worked as external and in-house consultant with clients across the globe to solve complex problems and deliver business benefits using the best of domain knowledge, technology, process, and analytics solutions. His international experience includes executing consulting assignments in the US, the UK, and Australia. His industry experience spans across verticals like retail, utility, telecom, banking and financial services, and insurance, and horizontals such as supply chain, marketing operations, IT, ITES, and analytics. Outside of work, he is a die-hard outdoor adventurer. He is also a voracious reader with keen interest in emerging technologies, and personal finance. He also loves blogging and organizing events.

name: Alpana Shah
bio: Alpana Shah is an Analyst for TCS MasterCraft™ TransformPlus, which is an intelligent automation product for deciphering legacy applications to modernize and migrate to cloud. With over 7.5 years of industry experience, she has managed the deployment and implementation of TCS MasterCraft™ TransformPlus in a wide variety of modernization projects, comprising more than 100 million lines of legacy code across various technologies. She holds a B.Tech degree in Information Technology from West Bengal University of Technology.

name: Amarnath Suggu
designation: Senior Consultant, US East, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance
bio: Amarnath Suggu is a senior consultant with the BFSI Technology Unit. He has over two decades of experience in the insurance industry, pre-dominantly with P&C insurers. He is interested in emerging technologies especially Artificial Intelligence and their applications in insurance industry.

name: Amgad Mina
bio: Ted is an expert in cloud strategy and transformation helping Fortune 500 companies drive business transformation, portfolio rationalization and cloud modernization initiatives. Ted played a pivotal role in large-scale cloud adoption programs of key clients by shaping and leading their multi-phase cloud transformation initiatives.

name: Amitabha Saha Roy
designation: Head, Global Practice, Sales and Marketing, Consumer Goods and Distribution, TCS
bio: Amitabha Saha Roy is the global practice head in sales and marketing area for the CPG industry vertical at TCS. He works with leading CPG companies on best-in-class commercial capabilities through initiatives like net revenue management, route to market, trade promotion management, and advanced analytics, AI-ML, and automation.

name: Amitabh G
designation: Enterprise architect, CMI
bio: Amitabh is an enterprise architect working with the Industry Advisory Group of TCS’ Communications, Media, and Technology business unit. With over 24 years of diverse experience in architecting, designing, and implementing BSS solutions for global telecom customers, he currently works with customers in the ANZ region. He helps them define digital transformation strategy and IT architecture roadmap.

name: Dr. Amit Kalele
bio: Dr. Amit is a solutions architect for TCS Incubation’s AI Performance and Trust Management (AIPM) program. He works on developing IP-led solutions in AI trust management and operationalization and has about two decades of experience in large scale parallel computing algorithms in industrial research.

name: Amit Kumar
designation: Marketing Head, TAP™, TCS Platform Solutions
bio: Amit Kumar is a management graduate and a Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) with 20+ years of experience in procurement, digital transformation, and operations with expertise in source-to-pay processes. He has cutting-edge knowledge on digital transformation techniques like Cloud, Artificial Intelligence, RPA, and Blockchain in procurement and accounts payable, and has keen interest in topics like sustainability, including ESG.

name: Amjed Mallick
designation: Enterprise architect, CMI
bio: Amjed is an enterprise architect with the Advisory and Transformation Group of TCS’ Communications, Media, and Technology (CMT) business unit. With over 22 years of experience in systems engineering, enterprise architecture, application integration, software design and development, and deployment of mission critical business support systems, he works with customers on BSS solutions, digital transformation strategies and architecture roadmaps.

name: Ananda Narayanan G.
designation: Global Head, GRC and Data Privacy CoE, Banking and Financial Services Cybersecurity Practice
bio: Ananda Narayanan G has been with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) for about 25 years. He is the global head, GRC and Data Privacy COE, for the banking and financial services cybersecurity practice. His primary focus areas include governance, risk and compliance, data security, and cloud security. Prior to this role, he worked as an information security manager (ISM) lead for the cyber security practice for three years, supporting internal security audits, managing security incidents, and supporting enterprise-level audits for multiple global customers.

name: Anand Chidambaram
bio: Anand Chidambaram is a Technology Lead and Domain expert in Capital Markets. He has over 25 years of experience in Banking and Financial markets with core expertise in Capital markets. Anand has worked with leading TCS clients in Europe and the US and has led many transformation programs for various clients. He holds an MBA degree in Finance and bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering.

name: Anand Kumar
bio: Anand Kumar heads digital transformation for TCS’ Life Sciences business in North America and is responsible for various growth and transformation projects. Over the past 22 years, he has worked with more than 200 clients worldwide. He engages with executive level stakeholders in pharma and MedTech, and health care professionals, health systems, and payers for market access in the US and Europe. He has led over 60 new product launches. He is a doctor and holds an MBA degree, a PhD in healthcare AI, and is also a Chartered Accountant and Chartered Finance Analyst with prestigious academic institutions across India, Europe, and the US.

name: Anand Sitaraman
designation: Head - Human Resources, Communications, Media, and Information Services
bio: Anand Sitaraman is the head HR for the Communications, Media, and Information Services (CMI) business unit in TCS. He is a senior HR leader with over 21 years of experience cutting across key functions including talent engagement, strategic staffing, and HR analytics. Anand focuses on building high-performance teams, nurturing talent, and partnering with the business to deliver superlative HR services to customers and employees. Prior to the current role, he was the global head of HR in TCS for the Enterprise Application Services business, where he drove several high-impact initiatives. Anand is an MBA (HR) from Xavier Institute of Social Service (XISS), Ranchi, India.

name: Dr. P.H. Anantha Desik
designation: R&I Head, TCS MasterCraft™
bio: Dr. Anantha Desik spearheads data analytics, modeling, machine learning, and deep learning with the integrated data management platform TCS MasterCraft™. He has also played a significant role in setting up the data analytics and actuarial CoE for the insurance business in TCS. He has over 25 years of experience in business consulting and delivery and functional experience in different industry domains such as insurance, healthcare, and finance. He has presented many papers on digital technologies in conferences and journals.

name: Anantha Ramakrishnan Srinivasan
designation: Senior Enterprise Data Architect, Healthcare Industry Unit, TCS
bio: Anantha Ramakrishnan Srinivasan is Senior Enterprise Data Architect of the Healthcare Industry Unit at TCS. Ananth has 24 years of experience in data management, business intelligence, data architecture, data warehousing, solution and system integration, mentoring, and research across multiple domains with prime focus on healthcare. He has notable experience in managing architectural roadmaps and implementing programs and projects aligned to best-in-class principles. He is currently involved in research and innovation in collaboration with leading universities and is pursuing a Doctoral Program in Healthcare Informatics.

name: Ananth Krishnan
designation: Former Executive Vice President & Chief Technology Officer, TCS
bio: Ananth directed Research and Innovation in TCS, India’s largest IT Company. Under his leadership, TCS has created a significant portfolio of patents, papers and IP. Ananth has served on several Governing Councils of Academia, Industry Advisory boards, and Government committees. He has been a regular invitee to the Board of TCS since 1999. He was elected a Fellow of INAE in 2013. He was named a Distinguished Alumnus of IIT Delhi in 2009. He has been listed in Computerworld’s Premier 100 IT Leaders (2007), and in Infoworld’s Top 25 CTOs (2007). Ananth is an M. Tech. in Computer Science and an M. Sc in Physics from the Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi.

name: Andrew Crane
designation: Senior Manager, Consulting, TCS
bio: Andrew Crane is a Senior Manager with TCS Consulting. He has earned his bachelor’s degree from the University of Miami and has over 25 years of supply chain experience. Andy’s experience and focus include Omni-Channel fulfillment, 3PL outsourcing, operational cost modeling and simulation, distribution and logistics process improvement.

name: Andrew Eil
designation: Head of Climate Risk, North America
bio: Andrew is the Head of Climate Risk for North America at TCS. He brings extensive expertise in climate risk, sustainable finance, strategy, and client management at the intersection of climate change and financial markets. He is also a published author in international environment and energy policy, climate finance, and technology transfer.

name: Andrew Essex
designation: Senior Managing Partner, TCS Interactive
bio: Andrew Essex is the former Chief Executive Officer of the Tribeca Film Festival and founding CEO of Droga5 . A highly creative strategic executive with three decades in branding, business development, and M&A, he is a proven entrepreneurial leader and culture builder with multiple exits, high-profile turnaround experience, skilled in recruiting, retaining, and managing talent and overseeing complex P&Ls, and a rainmaker with an extensive track record of generating high-margin revenue, crafting compelling narratives and operating complex enterprises in competitive markets.

name: Aneek Pal
designation: Industry Advisor, Domain Consultant, Agribusiness, TCS
bio: Aneek is a Specialist in the Manufacturing domain at TCS. He has over five years of experience spanning the agribusiness, food, and forestry industries.

name: Anil Sharma
designation: Head Corporate Incubation, TCS
bio: Anil is Head of TCS’ corporate incubation function that is actively engaged in spotting, building, and accelerating emerging businesses that harness novel technologies and innovative business models. During his 26 years, Anil has played various roles in strategy, business development and innovation and has been part of key incubation initiatives in TCS. He also heads TCS Foundation initiative Digital Impact Square that is incubating social impact start-ups in India.

name: Anindya Pradhan
designation: Industry advisor, Utilities Innovation and Transformation Group (ITG), TCS
bio: Anindya Pradhan is an industry advisor for Utilities at TCS. He has over 20 years of global business consulting experience in the utilities sector, spanning markets in the US, Canada, the UK, Europe, Australia, Japan, and India. Anindya is an alumnus of the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Ahmedabad. He started his career as a part of a power plant operations team. In his current role, he helps TCS' global utility clients discover, define, and generate value at the intersection of energy and digital technologies.

name: Anirban De
designation: Consulting Partner, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Anirban De is a Business Consultant for Manufacturing and Utilities, TCS. He has nine years of cross-functional experience in consulting and IT across manufacturing and utilities. Anirban has worked extensively in the areas of data monetization, data analytics, AI/ML application, data platform, and product management. He has been guiding customers to adapt to emerging business models

name: Aniruddha Mukherjee
designation: Researcher, Utilities, Telecom, Media and Information Services Corporate Marketing Research Group, TCS
bio: Aniruddha Mukherjee works as a lead in the Corporate Marketing Research group at TCS, focusing on research activities for utilities, telecom, media and information services sectors.

name: Anirudh Deodhar
designation: Scientist, TCS Research
bio: Anirudh Deodhar is a scientist at TCS Research with more than 10 years of experience in process modeling, ML, and digital twins. Anirudh and his team have won the Tata group level innovation award at Tata Innovista 2018 and the IT Innovation Award from Express IT awards in 2018, for their work on digital twin technology.

name: Anita Bachal
designation: Domain consultant, Life Sciences, TCS
bio: Anita has over 25 years of experience in global regulatory affairs, with 14 years of experience in strategy, CMC, and regulatory operations for biotech products and vaccines. She is green belt certified for her contribution to regulatory process enhancements through lean processes, regulatory industry benchmarking, use of automation, and best practices.

name: Anjan Krishna Ganguly
bio: Anjan, as part of TCS’ Advisory and Consulting practice of the Information Services business unit, focuses on developing innovative and next-gen solutions. He possesses in-depth knowledge of information services and the publishing value chain in areas such as credit bureaus, ratings, content life cycle, contracts, rights and permissions, collaborative learning, and social networking. With over two decades of experience, Anjan has played several key roles in TCS, and has been the lead analyst and solution architect for strategic and transformative solutions in the media and information services space.

name: Anjeel Babbar
designation: Consultant, Cloud Strategy and Transformation, TCS
bio: Anjeel Babbar is an expert in data and analytics technologies, and enterprise architecture. He has over 22 years of IT consulting experience in delivering business-focused, end-to-end full life cycle IT solutions for multiple industries.

name: Ankeet Dedhia
designation: Industry Principal, Amazon Web Services (AWS)
bio: Ankeet is currently the Industry Principal, Capital Markets Specialist at Amazon Web Services (AWS), focused on helping financial services customers with capital markets modernization using the power of Amazon’s cloud, Amazon’s business transformation, and leadership principles. Ankeet is passionate about helping organizations with digital transformation across the trade lifecycle: pre-trade, at-trade, and post-trade in capital markets using the power of cloud computing. Prior to joining AWS, Ankeet spent 15+ years in capital markets across trading, business and product leadership, and risk. He holds a master’s in finance from the Stuart School of Business, Illinois Institute of Technology. Ankeet holds 4 patents in post-trade risk management.

name: Ankita Singh
designation: Consultant
bio: Ankita Singh is a senior consultant in TCS. She has over 10 years of experience in consulting and managing IT infrastructure projects for MA&D programs. She has a deep knowledge of business process consulting and risk management. Her expertise lies in business transformation strategy and planning. She has successfully directed and managed multiple large-scale IT integration for MA&D programs. Ankita has completed her MBA from Welingkar Institute of Management, Mumbai, India. She loves reading and traveling in her free time.

name: Ankit Tiwari
bio: Ankit Tiwari is a Senior Engagement Manager with TCS' Consulting & Enterprise Solutions Practice. Ankit helps organizations develop a transformation strategy and implementation roadmap the integrated business planning and execution space to climb up the maturity curve. Ankit has spent more than 11 years helping customers, across industries and geographies, realize tangible business benefits by integrating people, process, and technology.

name: Ankur Kumar
designation: Assistant Consultant, North America Aero and Process Manufacturing ISU, Manufacturing & Utilities Business Unit, Tata Consultancy Services
bio: Ankur Kumar is Assistant Consultant in the Aero and Process division for Manufacturing at TCS. With seven years of industry experience, he has offered pragmatic approaches to customer challenges pertaining to supply chain, logistics, and fleet management. He holds a Master’s degree in supply chain and operations from the National Institute of Industrial Engineering (NITIE), Mumbai, India, and a Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering from Moradabad Institute of Technology, Uttar Pradesh, India. He is a certified supply chain professional (CSCP) from APICS. He also holds certifications from the International Supply Chain Education Alliance as a demand driven planner and leader (CDDP, CDDL).

name: Ankur Samaiyar
designation: Consulting strategist, Industrial and Automotive Manufacturing, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Ankur is a business and digital innovation strategist in the consulting and advisory practice in TCS focusing on automotive and industrial manufacturing. He is a passionate practitioner of marketing, sales, and aftersales life cycle management with 17 years of experience in the manufacturing business. He combines his industry and consulting experience to bring strategic and innovative perspective to customer lifecycle management. He holds a bachelor’s degree in electronics engineering from Kolhapur University, Maharashtra, India, a post graduate diploma in embedded & VLSI design from CDAC Noida, India, and an MBA in strategy and operation from MDI Gurgaon, India.

name: Ankush Mohla
designation: Head of Digital, Business Unit focused on Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Ankush is the Head of Digital for a large conglomerate at TCS. Ankush’s aim is to help clients with their growth and transformation journeys leveraging the TCS Business 4.0 approach - putting digital technologies/practices around user experience, cloud, automation and IoT at the core of every organization, and enabling them to develop the agility they need to embrace risks and innovate rapidly. Ankush comes with over 20 years of variety of industry exposure. He is passionate about reimagining cross-industry value chains through the lens of business outcomes and customer journeys with a strong focus on continuous innovation. Ankush holds a bachelor’s degree in Engineering and has completed Data Science Business Analytics course.

name: Anni Gupta
bio: Anni is a Pre-Sales & Solutions consultant with the TCS Platform Solutions unit, responsible for creating value for enterprises through tailoring solutions to meet their requirements, particularly in the area of procurement. He holds a dual-degree Master’s in Business Administration, and a Bachelor’s in Technology from Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management, Gwalior.

name: Anshoo Kapoor
bio: As the Head for Recruitment TCS UK&I, Anshoo has developed inclusive hiring practices, learning initiatives focusing on running culture and communication workshops both internally and for TCS' clients. Her areas of expertise include recruitment, integrating teams in culturally diverse set-ups, managing career aspirations, and designing interventions for organisational development.

name: Antony Kagoo
bio: Antony Kagoo, Head of Innovation, Communications, Media and Information Services, UK & EU, TCS Antony has 14 years of experience in the CMI industry, leading customer relationships across multiple CxO domains with a strong focus on contact centre, networks, CFO functions and emerging technologies. He has led Innovation for TCS’ CMI customers in the UK and Europe regions for about two years, evangelizing the 'Art of Possible' for the industry. Antony works with CMI firms to create and implement innovation strategies that enable them to deploy the right investment models, understand market propensity, and meet end user needs. He also works with TCS’ research teams to build futuristic propositions to create blue ocean markets for global CMI companies.

name: Anuj Khandelwal
bio: Anuj Khandelwal is an automation architect for HiTech at TCS. In his current role, he provides automation-related consultation and advisory services to TCS’ customers. Anuj has several certifications, including from the International Software Testing Qualifications Board, Microsoft, and the Scrum Foundation. He holds a bachelor's degree in Information Technology Engineering from Arya College of Engineering and Information Technology, Rajasthan, India.

name: Anupam Chakraborty
designation: Industry Advisor and Domain Consultant
bio: Anupam Chakraborty is an Industry Advisor and Domain Consultant in the Utilities Business Unit at TCS. In his capacity as an advisor, he leads grid modernization and strategic initiatives of machine vision in the Utilities Business Unit. Anupam has over 26 years of operational, management, and consultancy experience spanning IT and electricity utility environment, electricity distribution, transmission, generation (including renewables and alternate sources), customer relationship management, commercial and financial functionalities and business enterprise development. He has worked in multiple USAID projects and smart initiatives in his earlier assignments.

name: Anupam Singhal
designation: President - Manufacturing, Tata Consultancy Services
bio: Anupam Singhal, a seasoned leader in the technology sector, leads the Manufacturing business group at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). With more than thirty years of experience, he has consistently showcased his dedication to customer success through spearheading digital transformations and crafting impactful business strategies. His astute leadership has generated significant value for customers, resulting in multi-billion-dollar outcomes, and has also broadened TCS’ footprint across diverse domains. One of Anupam’s noteworthy achievements includes leading the digital transformation of a prominent customer’s legacy business, resulting in TCS being recognized as the 2016 Digital Innovator of the Year within the customer organization’s partner ecosystem. Additionally, he has played a role in enhancing TCS’ intellectual property by contributing to the development of the IDEA Framework for Contextualized Touch and Believe Point of Views © . Anupam champions diversity and social responsibility, spearheading initiatives such as Women in Technology Architecture (WITA) and Sadhana SamarpaN to inspire and empower associates. His efforts earned him the title of “The Equalizer” at the Weequity Awards 2022 and the Economic Times Human Capital Award for “Excellence in Social Initiatives” in 2023. Presently, he serves as a National Board Member for NPower, a prominent non-profit dedicated to promoting technological equity through philanthropic investments. He is an alumnus of the Harvard Business School’s Advanced Management Program. He holds an MBA degree in marketing from Sydenham Institute of Management Studies, Research and Entrepreneurship Education, Mumbai, India, and a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering from Dayalbagh Educational Institute, Agra, India.

name: Anup Chakraborty
designation: Senior Research Analyst
bio: Anup Chakraborty is a senior business research analyst in TCS’ Corporate Marketing Research unit. He has more than 14 years of experience focused on research-led advisory for sales leadership, business unit heads, and customers. Anup is a certified Design Thinker in Growth and Transformation Consulting from INSEAD Business School, a gold-certified mentor, and a TCS Ambassador Corps training faculty member.

name: Anurag Jain
bio: Anurag Jain leads Transformation Consulting Practices in the area of new product innovation, product lifecycle management (PLM) and master data management, for its global discrete manufacturing and process industry clients. He has over 27 years of experience in the industry and in consulting arena, and has been with TCS since past 12 years. He possesses rich industry experience in achieving Business Transformation comprising Product Innovation, Product Design and Development, Plant Engineering, Service & Quality and Marketing. He has worked with aerospace, automotive, farm equipment, capital goods, consumer durables, telecom, chemicals, and hi-tech industries, in different capacity and currently plays advisory roles for major programs and transformation journey. Anurag is a Mechanical Engineering graduate, and has been working with the TCS clients in North America, Europe, UK and Japan.

name: Anusha Sivaramakrishnan
designation: Consultant, Capital Markets Advisory, TCS
bio: Anusha Sivaramakrishnan is a domain consultant with the Capital Markets Industry Advisory Group of TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. She has over 20 years of experience in the capital markets space and has worked with leading Wall Street firms on their back-office transformation programs. Anusha specializes in utilities, derivatives, and buy-side processing and consulting in both wealth and asset management areas and has been involved in the development of IT solutions for TCS’ clients the world over.

name: Apurwa Loya
designation: Business Analyst, Network Solutions and Services
bio: Apurwa has rich experience delivering end-to-end telecom site engineering projects, implementing business intelligence, decision-making in new site planning (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G), driving revenue and network quality analysis, and finding the gaps and taking corrective actions. She is an electronics and telecommunication engineer with data scientist certification.

name: Aravind Chukkala
bio: Aravind is a business relationship manager with the Communications, Media, and Information Services business group of TCS UK and Europe. With 14 years of experience building and nurturing business relationships in domains like customer experience and journey design, business process architecture, he has led the establishment of TCS Pace Port™ Amsterdam – an innovation hub for the telecom industry.

name: Arijit Mukherjee
designation: Principal Scientist, TCS Research
bio: Arijit is a principal scientist at TCS Research. He works on intelligent edge and neuromorphic systems. He holds a PhD from Newcastle University, UK, and is a senior member of the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers. Arijit has 44 granted patents to his credit and 70 international publications.

name: Arindam Halder
bio: Arindam Halder wears the dual hat of being the delivery partner for a few provider engagements in TCS and also acting as a transformation partner for strategic initiatives within the Healthcare Provider segment. Over the period of 13 years in TCS, he has played multiple roles aligned with the healthcare domain, innovation, architecture and governance.

name: Arpan Pal
designation: Chief Scientist, TCS Research
bio: Dr Arpan Pal is a distinguished chief scientist and head of Embedded Devices and Intelligent Systems at TCS Research. He has over 28 years of experience in embedded systems, IoT, and signal processing. He received his Ph.D. from Aalborg University, Denmark, and B.Tech. and M. Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunications from IIT- Kharagpur, India.

name: Arpita Sen
designation: Innovation Evangelist, TCS
bio: Dr Sen is an innovation evangelist at TCS. She has over 18 years of experience in evangelism and product management, covering a range of domains across telecom, insurance, healthcare, biopharma, retail, and the internet of things.

name: Arunava A. Chakrabarty
designation: Sales Director, Retail – UK, EMEA, and India, Consumer Business Group, TCS
bio: Arunava is the Sales Director, Retail – UK, EMEA, and India for TCS’ Consumer Business Group unit. He is a highly experienced sales leader who has worked with several of TCS’ retail customers to anchor their business transformation and growth roadmaps. He has won the HR Thought Leader award for driving thought leadership in the CHRO forum from HRcommunity, a leading network of over 100,000 HR professionals across the Europe, the UK, and the US. He has won several accolades from the TCS Management and Customer Leadership. He is an acclaimed storyteller for industry roundtables and cultural concerts. He has performed as the Master of Ceremony at the British Parliament. Arunava is responsible for driving business outcomes for marquee retailers by working as the strategic advisor to the C-suite. He works in close collaboration with chief HR officers, chief financial officers, and chief supply chain officers to define their innovation and digital strategy and growth levers to enable the business transformation of their enterprises. With a successful stint of over two decades with TCS, Arunava has excelled in several roles in the areas of sales, pre-sales, program management, and delivery management. He has been acknowledged for his stellar contributions in delivering successful business and IT transformation programs for large scale global engagements. He has vast experience of working with customers across multiple geographies and diverse cultures including the US, Canada, the UK, the Europe, Middle East and India regions.

name: Arun Pradeep Surendra Mohan
bio: Arun is the Industry Solution Unit Head, Leading Travel, Transportation and Hospitality unit for Tata Consultancy Services in Europe. In a career spanning 25 years, Arun has extensive experience establishing strategic partnerships and in creating significant business value for customers in Travel, Transportation and Hospitality industry. He Joined TCS in 1995 and performed various Technical and Functional roles for Banking, Insurance, Telecom, HiTech and Utility customers in APAC, US and Europe. Arun holds an Engineering degree with specialisation in Computer Science.

name: Ashim Ganguly
designation: Functional consultant & CoE lead of Energy & Resources (E&R)
bio: Ashim is a functional consultant and offering owner for BPS Energy -Resources (E&R), with over 22 years’ of varied experience in Information Technology, Consulting & Business Process Outsourcing. Ashim has over 12 years of experience working for numerous mining and minerals customers across the globe. In his previous role, Ashim has lead several domain and IT infrastructure projects for opencast and underground mining operations. He has also worked closely with mining regulatory bodies, global networking solution providers and mining equipment testing laboratories globally.

name: Ashim Roy
bio: Ashim Roy is the Global Product Head of TCS MasterCraft™ DataPlus, which is an integrated data management software from TCS. Ashim carries more than 28 years of industry experience in business verticals such as manufacturing, investment banking and IT. Ashim pursues his interest in enterprise product development, particularly in the area of data privacy and data quality and has over 10 patents under his name. Ashim holds a master's degree in Robotics from IIT, Kanpur.

name: Dr Ashish Indani
bio: Dr. Ashish Indani is a qualified physician with an MBA in Clinical Trial Management and MIRCS (Research Methodology) and is working as a Domain Consultant for Advanced Drug Development (ADD) Platforms , Life Sciences unit, at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). With a vast experience of more than 18 years in the domain of clinical research, Dr Ashish is an expert on medical devices. He has authored many publications and books on diverse subjects, primarily medical devices, clinical research methodology, different therapeutic areas, and ancient Indian Vedic literature. In his current role, Dr. Ashish is working with the TCS Life Sciences ADD Platforms, for the development of innovative technology solutions with use of artificial intelligence and other modern technologies across various life sciences operations.

name: Ashish Khurana
designation: Retail Head, Americas, TCS
bio: Ashish is the head of the Retail business for Americas at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). A seasoned retail professional with an entrepreneurial mindset, he has been with TCS for 20+ years. Ashish focuses on emerging market strategies, driving digital opportunities, creating customer-centricity for retailers in the Americas. He resides just outside of Chicago in the US.

name: Ashish Thapliyal
designation: Consultant, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, TCS
bio: Ashish Thapliyal, a Consultant in TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit, is the client partner for a large US bank. He is responsible for building and growing relationships with leading BFSI enterprises across geographies and business segments. Over the last 21 years, he has used his expertise in domain, technology, and operations to drive strategic transformation focused on cloud and digital, for several of TCS’ BFSI clients.

name: Ashish Vyas
designation: Head of Cloud Infra Strategy and Modernization in TCS AWS Business Unit.
bio: Ashish Vyas leads Cloud Infra Strategy and Modernization in TCS’ AWS business unit. With over 20 years in TCS, he has led many strategic customer engagements globally and provided key solutions to address clients’ needs. His specializations include enterprise architecture and cloud technologies.

name: Ashok Krish
designation: Global Head, Advisory and Consulting, AI.Cloud, TCS
bio: Ashok Krish is head of the Advisory and Consulting function at the AI.Cloud unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). An interdisciplinary group of AI experts, the function offers deep domain knowledge, AI and GenAI engineering, and data science and ‘design for AI’ capabilities that help large organizations design, implement, and adopt predictive and generative AI at scale. The AI.Cloud unit helps large companies embrace an AI-first business architecture by bringing full-stack capability across all cloud hyperscalers, data platforms, and AI and GenAI technology stacks. Outside of work, Ashok is an expert on the science of Indian cooking. He is the author of Masala Lab: The Science of Indian Cooking, an Amazon best-seller published by Penguin Random House. He is also a classical violinist, guitarist, and cellist.

name: Ashok Natarajan
designation: Head, PLM Presales, Engineering & Industrial Services (EIS), TCS
bio: Ashok Natarajan is Head of PLM Presales in the Engineering & Industrial Services (EIS) business unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He has close to 19 years of experience, of which nearly 16 years have been in the CAD/PLM industry. Ashok is responsible for evangelizing TCS' portfolio of PLM solutions and services to address unique customer challenges across industries. He started his career as a product designer in the automotive industry and has held various roles thereafter such as Presales Manager, PLM business consultant and Industry Solutions Consultant, before his current role. Ashok holds a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from the PSG College of Technology, Coimbatore, India.

name: Ashok Pai
designation: Senior Vice President Global Head, Enterprise Cognitive Business Operations
bio: Ashok Pai is Senior Vice President at TCS and heads the Enterprise Cognitive Business Operations (CBO) service of the organization. The Enterprise CBO service practice at TCS helps customers in their journey towards autonomous business operations by embedding Al to transform enterprise functions, including finance and accounting, supply chain, sourcing and procurement, human resources, and customer experience management. Amid an ever-evolving business and technology landscape, he enables organizations to transform into perpetually adaptive enterprise by re-imagining their business operations through integration of automation, analytics, contextual insights, and cutting-edge Al technologies. Ashok led the conceptualization and design of TCS Cognix™, an AI-driven human-machine collaboration suite of pre-built digital solutions, to drive agility in operations transformation. He was closely involved in pioneering initiatives like setting up the All Women Business Process Services Center, a joint venture with GE, in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Over the past three decades, Ashok has played multiple leadership roles based in the US, Japan, Singapore and Australia, spanning technology, transformation, enterprise capability, and global centers management, working with clients in their transformation journey, and enhancing business value delivered. Having lived and worked in these diverse geographies, he brings a strong global perspective, has a deep understanding of different cultures, and business practices. Ashok earned his masters in technology (reliability engineering) from Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Bombay, and is a certified Six Sigma Black Belt. He is passionate about yoga and has done his masters in science (Yoga) from Swami Vivekananda University (S-VYASA), Bengaluru. He is also an avid long-distance runner and an ultra-marathoner.

name: Ashwini Kamat
designation: Senior consultant, BFSI
bio: Ashwini Kamat is a Senior Consultant with the Banking and Financial Services (BFS) business unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). A qualified Chartered Accountant, she has over 26 years of industry experience and currently leads the Finance and Reporting practice of the business unit.

name: Asif Kaba
designation: Engagement Director, TCS
bio: Asif Kaba is an Engagement Director in the Risk and Cyber Strategy Practice, with over 24 years of experience in information technology, cybersecurity, risk, and compliance. With his extensive experience in advisory cyberrisk practice, Asif has helped numerous financial services organizations establish, enhance, and revamp their environments to strengthen cyber-security maturity. He has managed programs for Fortune 100 firms involving large, complex, and highly regulated environments across multiple industries throughout the world and has also engaged with Regulators in the financial services sector.

name: Asif Tamboli
bio: Asif Tamboli is an autonomous driving (AD) Domain Consultant at TCS and works on both solution development as well as their rollouts with leading car manufacturers. He has more than 18 years of experience with multiple patents in autonomous control and artificial intelligence. His primary focus area is the end-to-end development of autonomous vehicles.

name: Aswin Unni
designation: Consultant , Consumer Business Group, TCS
bio: Aswin Unni is a consultant with experience in the Consumer Business Group (CBG) unit at TCS. He is currently focused on researching retail media networks (RMNs) and identifying market opportunities to leverage TCS’ capabilities. Aswin brings with him a strong background in strategy research and analysis across industries including retail, consumer packaged goods (CPG), and travel, transportation, and hospitality (TTH). He holds a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering from APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University, Thiruvananthapuram; an MBA in marketing from Amrita School of Business, Bangalore; and an MS in business analytics from SUNY Buffalo, New York.

name: Atul Jagnale
designation: Chief Technology Officer, UK and Europe, HiTech, TCS
bio: Atul Jagnale is the head of the Digital and Enterprise Business Transformation Unit and a CTO Leader for UK & Europe in the HiTech Professional Services Unit at Tata Consultancy Services. As head of the professional services unit, he focuses on designing new sales plays with a focus on innovation and platform-led growth and transformation for existing customers and new prospects. Atul has worked across numerous functions, including sales, strategy, relationship management, business consulting, and portfolio/program management. He has demonstrated thought leadership by creating, incubating, and implementation numerous strategies for digital organizations, including the first-ever enterprise-focused cognitive assistant, an ecosystem of self-operating business process and technology engines for self-serve and self-heal, and a comprehensive cloud transformation and management framework. He has conceptualized and implemented machine learning-based products that fuelled innovation and growth. Atul lives in London, UK and holds a Master’s degree in Electronics and Power from Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology.

name: Dr. Avijit Bhattacharyya
designation: Technology Head, ERP on Cloud platform
bio: Dr. Avijit Bhattacharyya has an experience of more than 31 years in TCS and has been involved in leadership roles for multiple national and overseas assignments across Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific, and India. He has served various prestigious assignments, both as a technology executive and program management specialist, in the deployment of high-value, enterprise-level IT projects. He has extensive experience in ERP and Supply Chain domains.

name: Avinash Patil
designation: Domain Consultant, Capital Markets Industry Advisory, BFSI, TCS
bio: Domain Consultant, Capital Markets Industry Advisory, BFSI, TCS

name: Avinash Vankodoth
designation: Consultant, Consumer Business Group – Indian Middle East and Africa, TCS
bio: Avinash Vankodoth is a passionate business consultant, and he is responsible for pre-sales and business consulting and has played diverse roles, including business analyst and functional expert, at TCS. He has primarily worked for the retail, CPG, and hospitality industries, and his core areas of expertise include designing customer experience strategy, channel strategy, vendor fitment, solutioning, and supply chain and program management. He has assisted several retailers in their core application modernization journey and helped them in deploying futuristic retail technologies like RFID. He is curious about advancing technology and has graduated with a computer science degree from the National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli. He pursued an MBA at the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad, where he majored in business strategy.

name: Avishek Mazumdar
designation: Industry advisor, CMI, TCS
bio: Avishek Mazumdar has over 24 years of experience in the information services industry, covering domain, technology, and solutions roles. He serves as an industry advisor in the TCS information services industry advisory group, guiding on matters requiring deep domain expertise, particularly in the credit bureau industry vertical. Additionally, he contributes to developing forward-looking strategies and key offerings for the information services business unit.

name: Ayush Kumar
designation: Senior engineer (AI and Machine Learning)
bio: Ayush Kumar is a senior engineer with TCS Platform Solutions having more than eight years of experience in AI and ML. He has worked extensively on development, deployment, maintenance, and support projects for large-scale software applications. His area of expertise includes solution design, and development and implementation of various AI and ML use cases. He is adept at designing and implementing AI/ML solutions for real-world applications, leveraging advanced analytics to drive actionable insights and inform strategic decision-making.

name: Babu Unnikrishnan (Unni)
bio: CTO, Manufacturing and Utilities, TCS Responsible for technology leadership and strategic advisory services, Unni works closely with TCS Corporate Technology Research, industry partners and academia in defining the research and innovation (R&I) roadmap as well as emerging technology strategy for enterprises the world over. As CTO, he defines digital architecture and formulates differentiated industry solutions for areas such as smart factory, networked logistics and intelligent assets. Unni holds a Master’s degree in Technology from IIT Bombay and is a regular speaker at technology forums and customer panels.

name: Baby Priya Aaby Lal
designation: Head, M365 Security CoE, Microsoft Security Practice
bio: Baby Priya Aaby Lal heads the modern workplace security CoE for the security practice at TCS’ Microsoft Business Unit. She has over 20 years of experience in the IT Industry, performing multiple roles across quality engineering, Microsoft modern workplace security, along with managing Centers of Excellence (CoE), solutioning, offering creation, assessment and value propositions, and delivery management.

name: Baby Veeraraghavan
designation: Business Architect Leader
bio: Baby Veeraraghavan is a business architect leader in the healthcare unit at TCS. She has over 23 years of experience in various domains, that include technology, solutions, product life cycle, delivery management, advisory and consulting for healthcare, travel and hospitality, and insurance. She has successfully managed multiple strategic initiatives of quality transformation programs with TCS’ Quality Engineering and Transformation practice and has conceptualized strategic solutions and QE platforms with utmost focus on quality, customer experience, and business value.

name: Balaji Bashyam
designation: Head, Industry Advisory, Travel and Logistics, TCS
bio: Balaji Bashyam is the head of industry advisory at in the Travel and Logistics unit at TCS. He helps travel providers like airlines, airports, and hospitality companies capture new business opportunities while enhancing their customer proposition. He has a deep understanding of the intricate ecosystems associated with the industry and the complex web of technologies underpinning their operations. Balaji provides industry-centric thought leadership and solutions essential for industry players to succeed in their respective transformation journeys. He is a compulsive traveller, always looking out for new experiences and cultures to embrace.

name: Balaji Jagannathan
designation: Head, Travel and Hospitality Practice, Travel Transportation and Hospitality, TCS
bio: Balaji Jagannathan heads the Strategic Initiatives Group of Travel and Hospitality at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), orchestrating digital transformation, IT strategy, innovation and consulting across travel and hospitality businesses, working closely with senior executives in the industry.

name: Balaji Paulraj
bio: Balaji Paulraj is a digital commerce consultant with over 17 years of experience. He has worked with leading retailers across the globe, guiding multiple retailers, across different lines of business, in their digital commerce transformation. His innovative commerce solutions have helped retailers create unique and differentiated propositions for their end-customers.

name: Balaji Raghavan
bio: Balaji Raghavan is a digital transformation leader with over 23 years of industry experience. An innovation and technology evangelist, he has worked with leading retailers and global enterprises to drive digital-led growth and transformation and helped them to progressively move up the digital maturity curve through modern digital architecture.

name: Balaji Ramachandramurthy
designation: Managing Consultant, Retail Strategic Initiatives, TCS
bio: Balaji has over 21 years of experience in retail, consumer packaged goods, and digital transformation. He has worked with retailers across continents in the areas of digital commerce, digital marketing, and store operations. Currently, he is responsible for conceptualizing and implementing applied AI in digital commerce and marketing.

name: Bala Karthik Baskaran
designation: Head, AI. Customer Engagement, Consumer Business Group, TCS
bio: Bala Karthik is a seasoned leader with over 20 years of experience empowering businesses to thrive through innovative AI and digital strategies. He has helped create intelligent, sustainable solutions that enhance customer experience and drive significant growth for his clients. Bala, a recognized thought leader, champions responsible technology and drives innovation in the development and implementation of inclusive technological solutions that serve a broader demographic.

name: Bashyam Selvaraj
designation: Consultant, TCS’ Banking and Financial Services (BFS)
bio: Bashyam Selvaraj is a Domain Consultant with the Financial Crimes Compliance CoE of TCS’ Banking and Financial Services (BFS) business unit. He has over 15 years of experience in banking and financial services with core expertise in AML, KYC and fraud prevention. Bashyam has led multiple consulting, process enhancement, and transition projects related to fraud detection and AML operations for TCS’ clients the world over. He has a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and Master’s degrees in Information Technology as well as Business Administration from Bharathidasan University, Tamil Nadu, India

name: Basil Chatterji
designation: Enterprise Architect, Energy Resource Unit, TCS-India
bio: Basil has over 26 years of experience in IT strategy and consulting, focusing on IT-led business growth and transformation. He participates in advisory and pre-sales activities and plays an evangelist role to take TCS solutions/frameworks/products to global customers. By pursuing digital technologies such as cloud, analytics, AI-ML, and agile practices, he takes a keen interest in leading and creating relevant frameworks, assets, and enablers to enrich sales and delivery of advisory engagements. Basil is currently responsible for IT advisory and growth and transformation opportunities across the energy, resource, and utilities segment in India and the Middle East and Africa region.

name: Bency M
designation: Marketing Analyst, Platform Solutions, TCS Chroma™
bio: Bency, a Marketing Analyst focused on uncovering market trends, conducting competitor analysis, and driving lead generation while crafting impactful content. Committed to delivering actionable insights to support strategic planning, brand positioning, and informed decision-making.

name: Bhalchandra Nisal
designation: Solution Advisor for Data and Analytics, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Bhalchandra Nisal is a solution advisor for data and analytics in TCS’ Manufacturing business unit. He has 20 years of experience in end-to-end implementation of data and analytics solutions. He has led several large enterprise-wide data and analytics programs for global customers spanning the manufacturing, BFSI, and transportation domains. He has also advised several of TCS’ customers in defining their data and analytics strategy.

name: Bhargab Banerjee
designation: Solution Architect, CMI, TCS
bio: Bhargab Banerjee is a solution architect in the Communications, Media, and Information Services business unit at TCS. With more than 12 years of experience, Bhargab has worked across domains such as retail, telecommunications, media, and information services. He is an Oracle certified Java developer, proficient in web application development, and is currently working as an architect in AWS cloud migration for a TCS client. He holds a bachelor’s degree in electronics and communication engineering from Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology (formerly known as West Bengal University of Technology). Being a tech enthusiast, Bhargab is an ardent reader of various technology related articles.

name: Bharti Tiwary
bio: Bharti Tiwary is part of TCS’ Supply Chain Consulting Practice. Bharti has over 20 years of industry and Oracle consulting experience, and has worked in the capacities of program/project manager, solution architect, and subject matter expert across implementation and business process transformation projects for various Fortune 500 clients. He is an active member of APICS, PMI (Certified), AMR, and Oracle's eBusiness and Fusion communities.

name: Bhavik Thakkar
bio: Bhavik Thakkar specializes in mortgage and capital markets and has over seven years of experience in post-cloning, document sorting, and Home Mortgage Disclosure Act processes. He completed his Master’s in Business Administration in finance from Pune University.

name: Bhushan Vishnu Dhotre
designation: Business Analyst, Products & Platforms, TCS Chroma
bio: Bhushan Vishnu Dhotre is a Business Analyst in the Product Services team of TCS Chroma. Out of 11 years of industry experience, his first eight years were dedicated to software testing as a Quality Analyst. Later, he worked in various roles across domains and technologies such as banking, human resources, automation, and payments. Currently, he is focusing on providing HR transformation solutions for the product.

name: Bhuwan Agrawal
bio: Bhuwan is the Regional Head, Central Europe, TCS. He has more than 18 years of experience partnering with leading companies on their growth and transformation journeys. He has held various functions at TCS in India, the UK, and the United States.

name: Bikram Das
bio: Bikram Das is Chief Data Architect, Chief Data Officer initiatives with TCS' Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. With over 25 years of experience in data management and consulting space, he has managed several data initiatives for our global clients across industry verticals. Das specializes in metadata management, data quality, and data governance including the evolving big data space. He has a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur, India.

name: Biswaketan Kundu
designation: Senior Solution Architect and Innovation Lead, Geospatial Service Delivery Unit, EIS, TCS
bio: Biswaketan Kundu (Biswa) is the Innovation Lead for the Geospatial service delivery unit within the Engineering Industrial Services (EIS) business unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He has over 18 years of experience in the research and development of geospatial products and business solutions. Biswa has successfully delivered several strategic projects across utilities, oil and gas, insurance, and retail industries, and is responsible for developing innovative, cutting-edge technology solutions. He is also involved in sales activities to deepen existing relationships and acquire new customers. Prior to joining TCS, Biswa worked with leading industry players such as Rolta and Esri. He has a PhD degree in Earth Sciences from the Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Mumbai, India.

name: Biswanath Bhattacharya
designation: Managing Partner, Consulting and Business Development, TCS, APAC
bio: Biswanath Bhattacharya is a Managing Partner with TCS, focusing on manufacturing, natural resources, and energy sectors. Biswanath has been a management consultant for over 20 years and has worked on strategy, design and governance of growth and transformation initiatives for client groups across geographies. Biswanath has a bachelor’s degree in engineering and a postgraduate diploma in management from the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad.

name: Blake Hansen
designation: Partner, M&A Services, Tata Consultancy Services
bio: Blake Hansen is a senior partner and leader in TCS’ M&A Services. With over 35 years of experience in management and IT consulting, Blake has led numerous M&A, optimization and transformation initiatives with Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies. He specializes in assisting CXOs with enhancing business performance through both business and technology. He has worked across numerous industries and countries. Blake is based in Northern California.

name: Bobby Philip
bio: Bobby has over 20 years of experience in Infrastructure Service (IS) Delivery spanning end-to-end IT IS operations in data centers. In his TCS career of 13 years, he has gained expertise in command center operations, end-user computing, data center operations, IS tools, migration, transformation, and implementation. Bobby currently lives in the UK. Apart from spending quality time with his family, he enjoys music and reading. He is also passionate about mentoring his team.

name: Bodhisatta Biswas
designation: Business Analyst, Corporate Market Research
bio: Bodhisatta, is a core member of TCS' Corporate Research and Advisory arm and has been instrumental in creating business opportunities and driving customer engagements for Europe sales through advisory research and insights. He was earlier part of the presales team in the utility domain where he played an active role in managing bids, engaging with stakeholders, creating solutions, formulating resource requirements, and supporting pricing model finalization. He has a keen interest in operations and has experience in delivery roles with stints in SAP S/4HANA modules. He is an MBA graduate from IIM Kozhikode, a consistent academic performer, and a passionate table tennis player.

name: Brigit Dominic
designation: Functional Consultant, TCS
bio: Brigit Dominic is a Functional Consultant within TCS Platform Solutions focusing on the HR Transformation solution of the unit. In her career of over 6 years, she has worked with various reputed clients and deployed HCM solutions for them. She is now a Pre-Sales and Solution Consultant for the HR solution.

name: B Vijaya Kumar
bio: B Vijaya Kumar is currently helping customers in manufacturing industry to make customer centric decisions for new product launches using new currency of organizations, data in Internal & external social media networks. Vijay is a domain consultant with Innovation & Transformation Group (ITG) in Manufacturing Industry Solutions Unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). A certified professional in New Product Development, he has 11 years of experience spanning across Innovation management, product planning, product design & development and strategic planning functions.

name: Carlos A. Gomez
designation: Senior Director, Wells Fargo Securities
bio: Carlos A. Gomez is the Senior Director, Asset Services and Syndicates Operations at Wells Fargo Securities. For over 30 years, Carlos has worked in global organizations ranging from investment banking, broker dealers, and custodial services. He has been responsible for deploying global footprint strategies, technology implementations, and operating models across London, Hong Kong SAR, Singapore, and India. Prior to joining Wells Fargo in 2021, Carlos held leadership roles at organizations such as Deutsche Bank, BoFA, and UBS. Carlos was educated in the University of Puerto Rico, and is an active parent, avid percussionist, and a motorcycle rider.

name: Chandan Sahu
designation: Functional Consultant, High Tech
bio: Chandan Sahu is a functional consultant with TCS’ Technology, Services, and Solutions business unit. Backed by deep expertise in finance strategy, he has been part of several business transformation engagements for TCS’ customers. With over nine years of work experience, Chandan is current working on research and innovation in the field of finance transformation.

name: Chandra Shekaran
bio: Chandra Shekaran is a Senior Consultant with the Cards and Payments practice within the Banking and Financial Services (BFS) business unit of Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He has over two decades of experience in implementing retail and wholesale payment systems for a host of firms ranging from card issuers, acquirers, and remittance players to regional and international networks and wholesale payment firms. Shekaran's areas of expertise include core transaction processing and risk management platforms, and he anchors strategic consulting and transformation programs for TCS' leading clients.

name: Chandra Shekaran
designation: Senior Consultant, Cards and Payments Industry Advisory Group, Banking, Financial Services and Insurance, TCS
bio: Chandra Shekaran is a senior consultant with the Cards and Payments practice of TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He has over two decades of experience in implementing retail and wholesale payment systems for a host of firms ranging from card issuers, acquirers, and remittance players to regional and international networks and wholesale payment firms. Shekaran's areas of expertise include core transaction processing and risk management platforms, and he anchors strategic consulting and transformation programs for TCS' leading clients.

name: Charusheela Thakur
designation: Domain Consultant, TCS ADD Metadata Repository
bio: Charusheela works as a Domain Consultant for the TCS ADD Life Sciences Platform and has been with TCS for over nine years. She has been working in the pharmaceutical industry for almost 20 years and specializes in areas such as clinical trial reporting, standardization, and analytics. She has a master’s degree in Statistics from the University of Mumbai.

name: Chayan Bandyopadhyay
bio: Chayan Bandyopadhyay is a Senior Research Analyst in the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) unit within the TCS Corporate Marketing Research and Advisory Group. He has around eleven years of cross-industry experience across verticals such as information technology, telecom, banking, and energy. With an interest in cutting-edge technologies and their effects on various industries, Chayan enables strategic decisions within the company through his research and advisory in his current role. Chayan is a Gold medalist during his MBA stint and has completed B. Tech. in Electronics and Communications Engineering

name: Chetan Hirurkar
designation: Senior Supply Chain Consultant, Consumer Goods and Distribution, TCS
bio: Chetan has over 25 years of experience. He has played multiple roles such as business architect, delivery partner,and ERP consultant, and designed multiple digital platform solutions.

name: Chinmaya Dikshit
bio: Chinmaya is a Business Analyst with the Platform Solutions Unit at TCS and is associated with TAP™ - TCS’ procurement platform. He has completed his Bachelor of Engineering from Biju Patnaik University of Technology, Odisha, and has an overall experience of 10 years with over 9 years in the ‘Procurement to Pay’ domain. He is currently responsible for implementing new functionalities in procurement as well as the Accounts Payable module aimed at making work easier for customers.

name: Chiranjib Bhattacharjee
designation: Domain Consultant, Open Banking Strategic Initiative, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, TCS
bio: Chiranjib Bhattacharjee is a Domain Consultant in the Open Banking Strategic Initiatives group with TCS Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance business unit. He is a part of a small digital native team operating as a startup within TCS. He has over 15 years of experience in IT consulting and solution development across Insurance and Retail Banking domains. Chiranjib is an intrapreneur who designs next-gen digital propositions for global customers for their small and medium business banking, retail banking and wealth management portfolios. He is an alumnus of XLRI, Jamshedpur and Jadavpur University, Kolkata, India.

name: Chris Burggraeve
bio: Chris is the founder of Vicomte, former global CMO of AB InBev, and former President of the World Federation of Advertisers. More info on his books, articles, and bio on LinkedIn.

name: Claire Cumberland
designation: Senior Business Consultant, Retail, TCS
bio: Claire is a senior business consultant with TCS’ Retail Business Consulting Services group. She is an experienced transformation leader, energized by providing customer-focused consulting services to retailers. With over 20 years of experience, she has deep knowledge of the retail industry, including change management, retail operations, and commercial, specializing in space, range, and display. She enjoys new challenges and working with retailers globally to deliver benefits across the end-to-end value chain. Claire is proud to be the co-chair of The Hive (TCS UK), the gender equity network, and is passionate about supporting and fostering inclusion.

name: Claire Yan
designation: Engagement Senior Manager
bio: Claire is a chartered financial analyst (CFA) with over 15 years of professional experience in finance and information technology consulting. She specializes in M&A with focus on cross-border business operational solutions, process transformation planning, global corporate integration strategies, post-merger information system, and business process integration services. Throughout her career, she has led multiple domestic and international M&As with post-merger business operational transformations, change management process, risk management, and corporate strategy initiatives.
