Prior to consulting, she participated in large-scale IPOs as well as M&A transactions at a prominent investment bank.

name: Courtney Wood
designation: M&A Services, and Thought Leadership Director, Tata Consultancy Services
bio: Courtney Wood leads thought leadership development for TCS’ M&A Services. Courtney has spent over 25 years in management consulting, supporting both large and early stage enterprises in producing meaningful outcomes by developing the right business strategies as well as aligned ‘people, process, and technology’ constructs and roadmaps to realize their transformational goals. Prior to consulting, Courtney spent four years in commercial lending and investment banking, as well as earned an MBA from Columbia Business School.

name: Dan Davis
designation: Engagement Manager, M&A Services, TCS
bio: Dan Davis is a technology strategy and M&A professional with experience in-house and as a consultant for Private Equity, LBO and venture capital firms, focusing on optimizing efficiency and increasing value in target companies. Dan worked with Ernst Young, Centre Partners Management and a municipal bond insurance start-up firm. Dan has acted as technology lead and IT Director in the high-tech, manufacturing, and healthcare fields as operating partner and on-staff executive. Dan has over 20 years of management consulting and industry experience in the M&A, Cybersecurity, Data Privacy, and Infrastructure domains. He is a Microsoft-certified Systems Engineer and received his MBA from Columbia Business School.

name: David Doherty
designation: CIO, Jurassic Fibre
bio: David is the CIO at Jurassic Fibre, a UK Alternative Fibre Broadband ISP building and operating in the South West of England UK. David is responsible for the strategic System and IT Technology direction of the business and day to day running of all internal IT services as well as Cyber Security. David has a long career in the Telecoms sector and has held senior positions in IT, Product Development and large Programme change management at organisations such as Gamma Telecoms, Ofcom, Easynet and NTL (now Virgin Media). David has in the past been a trustee of the charity the Learning Foundation.

name: David Lotz
designation: Higher Education Advisory Partner, TCS
bio: David Lotz is the lead education industry advisor and advisory partner at TCS, with 33 years of experience in higher education, including 16 years working in senior advancement management roles at several prestigious US-based universities. He has been a leader in higher education consulting practices, leading college and university engagements with an emphasis on design thinking, student and alumni engagement, and change management.

name: Dean Ramsay
designation: Principal Analyst, TM Forum
bio: Dean has more than 20 years’ experience in the telecoms software industry, firstly with global operators such as Verizon and now as a trusted analyst. For the last 10 years he has worked with the world’s leading software vendors writing thought leadership content and advising on OSS and RAN topics.

name: Debabrata Biswas
bio: Debabrata Biswas is a data architect with TCS’ Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He has more than 11 years of IT industry experience with extensive expertise in building end-to-end data pipelines, BI process management, and data platform modernization with cloud for TCS’ clients. He is part of the BFSI CDO strategic initiatives team and works with BFSI firms across the globe on data initiatives and cloud transformations.

name: Debarghya Mukherjee
designation: Product Engineering Manager
bio: Debarghya is an experienced Product Engineering Manager with over 13 years of knowledge behind him, leading cross-functional teams and delivering innovative technology solutions. In his current role, Debarghya oversees the development of cutting-edge product features from conception through launch. His expertise lies in Java, J2EE, REST, and microservice architecture. He is also an Oracle-certified Java technical architect. Debarghya holds a bachelor’s degree in computer science and engineering. He is an avid numismatist and has built an enviable collection of coins, paper money, tokens, and medals.

name: Debarupa Das
designation: Global Head of EV-ONe
bio: Debarupa Das is the Global Head of EV-ONe, TCS’ Electric Vehicle and Battery Ecosystem business, leading the global portfolio in all the key markets for the organization. She brings in more than 21 years of wide-ranging experience in consulting and IT, board-level IT strategy (for C-suite executives), solution design, program delivery, and key account management. Her current area of focus is around the end-to-end electric vehicle ecosystem and eMobility-related innovation.

name: Debasish Das
bio: Debasish is an enterprise architect with TCS’ Cyber Security practice, with expertise in innovation-led product engineering, video analytics, enterprise security, and risk management. He has more than 17 years of industry experience and has led CoE teams and strategic security initiatives for TCS’ global customers. Debasish has filed four patents in video streaming and cyber security and has authored 10 research papers on cloud and digital platforms. He holds a Master’s degree in technology from BITS Pilani, India, and has done an executive course in management from IIM, Calcutta, India.

name: Debasis Thakur
designation: Senior Business Consultant, Technology Advisory Group, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, TCS
bio: Debasis Thakur (Deb) is a senior payments consultant with the Payments Solutions group within the Banking and Financial Services (BFS) business unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He has over 19 years of industry experience in banking cards and payments. Deb has anchored several transformational projects for TCS customers, and is currently focusing on innovations in the payments space, specifically on digital payments and emerging Fintechs to help global financial institutions reimagine their payment processes in light of the new digital technologies.

name: Deepak Mavatoor
designation: Head – Supply Chain and Plant Operations, Growth and Transformation, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Deepak Mavatoor is a Partner with the Innovation and Transformation Group, in the MFG business unit at Tata Consultancy Services. He leads the North America Supply Chain business advisory activities and support clients across automotive, discrete manufacturing aero and process industries to address the business challenges through transformational and innovative interventions. Deepak has around 20 years of combined industry and consulting global experience. He has an MBA from Ross School of Business, University of Michigan and an engineering degree from Mysore University.

name: Devang Patel
designation: Solutions Head, CTO Incubation Group, Research and Innovation, TCS
bio: Devang Patel heads solutions in the Incubation Group of TCS' Research and Innovation (R&I) unit. With over 24 years of experience in the IT Industry, Devang has mastered the art blending technology and business towards successfully incubating an idea into money making products and solutions for TCS. As a practitioner, Devang is responsible for ideating, strategizing, conceptualizing, designing and shaping ideas and leading them to a successful scale-up. Devang holds a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and Engineering from University of Mumbai, India, and an MBA from the Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies, Mumbai, India. Devang's current technology interest is in Artificial Intelligence and Cognitive Information Extraction.

name: Devashish Das
designation: Senior Business Consultant, Manufacturing
bio: Devashish Das is Senior Business Consultant with the Manufacturing Excellence, Growth & Transformation Group for the UK & Ireland Manufacturing Business Unit at Tata Consultancy Services. With 15 years of industry experience, he leads consulting engagements in business process re-engineering and digital transformation for global manufacturing clients. His earlier responsibilities included development of new automotive components and establishing their manufacturing facilities with an auto OEM. He has a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from NIT, Durgapur.

name: Devjeet Sarkar
designation: Solution Architect, Open Banking Strategic Initiative, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, TCS
bio: Devjeet Sarkar is a Solution Architect in the Open Banking strategic initiative group of TCS Banking, Financial services, and Insurance (BFSI). He has over 16 years of experience in Retail Banking, IT and Consulting with expertise in Open Banking and next gen digital banking. He is also an intrapreneur designing next-gen digital propositions as part of a garage team operating as a startup within TCS. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication from BN College of Engineering, Amravati University, Maharashtra.

name: Dev Narayan Choudhary
bio: Dev Narayan Choudhary is a cyber security solution architect at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He is a subject matter expert on MDR security solutions, with more than 10 years of experience in cyber security. He specializes in security operation center, SIEM, endpoint protection, cloud security, and vulnerability management programs.

name: Dheeraj Gupta
designation: PreSales Consultant
bio: TCS is an amazing place to work and interact with some of the best business intellectuals and industry visionaries. The organizational culture of continuous learning helps me in keeping up with the ever-changing technology landscape and drives my motivation to scale higher!

name: Dheeraj Shah
designation: Head - Retail Supply Chain Practice, Retail, TCS
bio: Global Head - Business Transformation and Supply Chain Management, Retail Business Group, TCS Dheeraj has more than 23 years of experience working with global retailers in supply chain strategic initiatives and pioneering the use of technologies like AI/ML, IOT, block chain, and robotics and automation. He has been instrumental in conceptualizing and developing key supply chain solutions including our AI-powered solution, TCS Cognitive Supply Chain. He has applied for three patents across warehouse operations, reinforcement learning powered forecasting and replenishment, and e-commerce fulfillment.

name: Dhritiman Chatterjee
designation: Domain Consultant, Life sciences, TCS
bio: Dhritiman Chatterjee is a domain consultant for the medtech industry within the TCS’ Life Science and Healthcare business group. He has spent over 18 years in the manufacturing domain and has led various transformation engagements for TCS’ customers in the life sciences, energy and resources, and utilities, and manufacturing sectors.

name: Dimple Beck
bio: Dimple is a domain specialist in the media and entertainment industry with over 18 years of experience. Currently, she works as an industry advisory consultant. Beck is responsible for business opportunity strategy and execution, innovative experience design, digital strategies, and transformations for customer organizations.

name: Dinanath Kholkar​
bio: Vice President, Global Head of Analytics & Insights​ In this digital economy, any organization needs to harness the art of possibility by constantly re-inventing itself to stay relevant to its customers. I firmly believe that the CSBS curriculum designed by TCS will empower students to familiarize with current business challenges, study cutting edge technology and equip themselves to become problem solvers of tomorrow.

name: Dinesh Mohata
designation: Retail & CPG Segment Head, Middle East & Africa
bio: Dinesh is a Senior Retail Industry Advisor and a Data Evangelist. Dinesh has worked extensively in client implementation projects with large footprints encompassing end-to-end Retail Processes focusing on Data Quality Attributes.

name: Dinesh Salve
designation: SAP Technical Architect
bio: Dinesh Salve is an SAP technical architect with more than 15 years of experience. He has worked in several projects, playing an instrumental role in not only designing, configuring, and implementing SAP solutions but also developing and maintaining SAP functional specifications and technical specifications documentation. He specializes in SAP ABAP, BASIS, WD, WF, Interfaces, PI/PO, EP, HCM, and SEN. He completed his MBA and bachelor’s in engineering from Mumbai University.

name: Dinesh Srivasthav Puvvada
designation: Researcher, TCS Research
bio: Dinesh has been with TCS Research for over three years, specializing in full-stack data science and machine learning. As a Researcher, he has prominently worked on blockchain forensics and developing AI-based solutions to meet business requirements. His interests include developing applications of digital image processing, computer vision, and natural language processing to address real-world problems.

name: Divya Venugopal
bio: Divya Venugopal completed her Bachelor’s in Electronics and Communication Engineering, and is now leading Product Engineering with Components Engineering Group. She leads the Engineering of Application Cloud Migration Edition of TCS MasterCraft™ TransformPlus, which is an intelligent automation product for modernizing legacy applications to the latest technology, and migrating them to the cloud. She has more than12 years of industry experience and continuously contributes to building state-of-the-art product solutions that help in application modernization and digital transformation to cloud.

name: Doug Tinning
designation: Product Marketing Manager, TCS DSS
bio: Doug Tinning is the Product Marketing Manager for TCS’s Digital Software & Solutions Intelligent Urban Exchange smart cities product. Prior to DS&S Doug was a Product and Enablement Manager for enterprise ECM/BPM solutions at IBM and FileNet Corporation.

name: Dr. Anantha Desik
bio: Dr. Anantha Desik is currently spearheading data analytics, modeling, machine learning and deep learning with the integrated data management platform TCS MasterCraft™ DataPlus at TCS. He has also played a significant role in setting up the data analytics and actuarial CoE for the insurance business in TCS. He has over 30 years of experience cutting across business consulting, delivery, and functional experience in different industry domains such as insurance, health care and finance. He has published many papers in conferences and journals on digital technologies.

name: Dr. Harshad Khadilkar
designation: Senior Scientist, TCS Research
bio: Harshad Khadilkar is a scientist in the Decision Sciences and Algorithms Lab within TCS Research & Innovation. His areas of expertise include analysis, modeling, and control of networked systems with a special focus on transportation and energy. Harshad holds a PhD in Aeronautics and Astronautics from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

name: Dr Kanwar Preet Singh Sandhu
designation: Global Head of Strategic Initiatives, Cyber Security
bio: Dr. K P S Sandhu is the Head of Global Strategic Initiatives in TCS’ Cybersecurity unit. He has 25 years of extensive experience within which he has delivered on cybersecurity projects across banking, financial services, insurance, healthcare, retail, travel and hospitality, and more. His areas of expertise span security architecture, roadmap and strategy, risk management, data protection, DevSecOps, cloud security, and artificial intelligence. In his current role, he focuses on strategic initiatives, forward-looking emerging areas of cybersecurity, conceptualizing strategic solutions, and fostering partnerships for strategic co-innovation.

name: Dr Mahesh Mynam
designation: Senior Scientist, TCS Research
bio: Dr Mynam is a senior scientist at TCS Research. He earned his PhD in chemical engineering from Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay. His research interests include molecular and mesoscopic modelling of fluids, especially, molecular modelling of novel Lithium-ion battery electrolytes, and lattice Boltzmann modelling of polymers in micro-confinements. He has published several refereed journal articles, filed patents, and presented his work at various national and international conferences.

name: Dr. Srinarayana Nagarathinam
bio: Srinarayana Nagarathinam is a Senior Scientist and Lead Researcher for the biosafe and energy-smart building program at TCS Research. He holds a PhD from the Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Sydney. Dr Nagarathinam is a recipient of the prestigious postdoctoral fellowship award by the Department of Science and Technology of the Australian government. He has extensive experience in thermal management of building systems, computational fluid dynamics, and heat transfer. His recent research interests include the application of physics-based and ML/AI-based techniques to optimal control of heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems.

name: E Asharaf
designation: Solution architect, TCS
bio: E Asharaf is a solution architect at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He’s currently with TCS’ Microsoft Business Unit (MBU) and part of the business unit’s Edge to Cloud team. He holds 25 years of experience in IT. Asharaf assists global customers in choosing the required automation for their operations, and the best-fit solutions and technologies especially on Microsoft Azure, for their business. His current focus is on combining 5G network functions and edge computing to deliver ultra-low latency edge solutions for business transformations.

name: Fenil Desai
bio: Fenil Desai is a Digital Architect with TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance unit. With over 13 years of experience, Fenil has worked with leading travel and insurance clients across India and the UK. He has solved complex problems and produced business benefits by leveraging technology, analytics, and process improvement. Fenil is passionate about emerging technologies, especially augmented reality and its applications in the insurance industry. He holds an MCA degree from South Gujarat University, India

name: Fenton Aylmer
designation: President - Donadea, Inc. and Market and Strategy Partner, Entelligent
bio: Fenton Aylmer, a banking risk management veteran, is the President of Donadea, Inc., a strategy and risk advisory services company. He is a lecturer in the Enterprise Risk Management Master of Science program at Columbia University’s School of Professional Studies. He also serves as Entelligent’s Banking Solutions Lead and is the creator of its Loan Book application.

name: Fin Kavanagh
bio: Fin Kavanagh is a writer in TCS UK and Europe Communications team. He is based out of the TCS London office, where he works alongside colleagues on content for events, campaigns and general media.

name: Gajanan Kamble
designation: Global Head, Software Product Engineering Services, TCS
bio: Gajanan Kamble is the global head of the Software Product Engineering Services group within TCS’ Technology, Software, and Services business unit. With over 26 years of experience in the high tech industry, Gajanan is an AI expert with a considerable body of work done at the Tata Research Development and Design Center (TRDDC).

name: Gal Mordechai
designation: Strategic Business Manager
bio: Gal is a an ex TCSer and was a Senior Strategic Business Manager at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Next Generation Strategy Practice and focused on blockchain and its impact on organizations and business processes. In his role, Gal assisted clients from various industries to understand blockchain technology and its disruptive power, develop new business strategies and use cases, and design execution roadmaps. Gal is an MBA from Duke Universitys Fuqua School of Business where he focused on Strategy, Innovation & Entrepreneurship. Prior to this, Gal worked with Siemens financial team and also served as a Combat Engineer Military officer on the Israeli Defense Forces (IDF).

name: Ganesh Sivakumar
designation: Platform Architect
bio: Ganesh Sivakumar is an Azure platform architect with TCS’ Microsoft business unit and part of the Cloud Exponence Engineering team. He has 15 years of IT experience. Ganesh assists global customers in choosing the required automation for operations, right solutions and technologies, especially Microsoft Azure technologies.

name: Ganesh Tonde
designation: Lead Consultant, Software Product Engineering Services, TCS
bio: Ganesh Tonde is a lead consultant with the Software Product Engineering Services group of TCS’ Technology, Software, and Services business unit. With over 24 years of experience, Ganesh has held diverse roles like program management lead, software product architect, and platform development lead. Ganesh specializes in data and analytics.

name: Ged Roberts
bio: Ged Roberts is the Global Head of Operations and Delivery Excellence for HiTech at TCS. With over 30 years of experience, he is responsible for maintaining a single global service standard across the business unit, and for ensuring that TCS' customers experience certainty and assured service delivery.

name: Geoff Melick
bio: Geoff Melick is the Executive Creative Director for TCS Interactive Life Sciences. Geoff’s passion is to help clients reimagine the power of delivering effective customer-centric marketing strategy and communications while leveraging the strong TCS analytics and digital technology. He has founded and managed multiple digital agencies and brings over 30 years of pharma and med device domain experience with a strong background in digital marketing. He continues to specialize in delivering digital marketing and creative campaigns.

name: Giridharan Varatharajan
bio: Giridharan Varatharajan leads Cloud Exponence Engineering and is an Azure platform architect with TCS’ Microsoft business unit. With more than 18 years of experience, he works with TCS’ clients the world over in the areas of consulting, automation and solutioning for Microsoft Azure technologies.

name: Girish Ramachandran
designation: President, Growth Markets
bio: As President of Growth Markets - Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East and Africa (MEA), Latin America (LATAM), India Enterprise, Public Services (Global) & Corporate Affairs, Girish manages an extensive business portfolio with tremendous growth valued at USD ~5.6 billion across 35+ countries, empowering a diverse workforce of 75,000+ professionals in TCS – one of the world’s most admired companies in 2023 by Fortune Magazine and second most valuable IT services brand in 2024 Global 500 IT Services Ranking by Brand Finance. Girish is a visionary leader adept at navigating dynamic technological landscapes, ensuring sustained growth, and committed to building high-performing and result-oriented teams. Under his stewardship, TCS has ventured into new growth markets and expanded its sustainability and community outreach footprint.

name: Godfrey Mathais
bio: Godfrey Mathais is a Technical Consultant for the Incubation team for QC and is responsible for identifying big bet opportunities in the area. He has over 15 years of experience in the areas of cognitive solutions like data extraction, chatbots, and IoT solutions. He started out as a multiple stack mobile developer with an extensive experience in designing and developing Android SDKs. Godfrey holds a bachelor’s in computer science engineering from Mumbai University.

name: Gokulaparthiban C N
designation: Innovation Evangelist, TCS
bio: Gokulaparthiban is an Innovation Evangelist at TCS. He works closely with a Research Area at TCS Research to contextualize the innovation offering for various industry verticals. Prior to this role, he has had over 12 years of experience in engineering operations and new product development for heavy equipment and industrial products.

name: Gopal CV
designation: Head, Microsoft Business Unit, ANZ
bio: Gopal C V heads TCS' Microsoft Business Unit for Australia and New Zealand. With more than three decades in the technology sector on the consumer and provider sides, he provides consultancy to TCS' clients as they traverse on the path of adopting technology advances for enhancing and reimagining their business.

name: Govindaraja V
designation: Industry Advisor, Cognitive Business Operations - ESG & Sustainability, BFSI, TCS
bio: Govindaraja V is part of the ESG Centre of Excellence in TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He has over 23 years of experience and has worked at leading Indian banks, besides spending a decade at India’s central bank, the Reserve Bank of India. Govindaraja has completed a certificate program in sustainable finance from the University of Cambridge, UK. He holds a PhD degree in management.

name: Govindaraja V
bio: Govindaraja V is part of the Business Operations business unit at Tata Consultancy services (TCS), and heads the AML CoE for the group. He has over twenty years of experience and has worked in some of the leading banks in India, besides spending a decade at the Reserve Bank of India. He holds a Master's degree in Science from the Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Coimbatore, India, and is a Certified Associate of the Indian Institute of Bankers.

name: Gurpreet Singh
bio: As a US mortgage domain consultant, Gurpreet has over 15 years of diverse experience in handling E2E mortgage operations and leading consulting assignments. He is a customer leader for three leading US mortgage accounts. During his career, he worked with top US banks and mortgage lenders in managing operations and partnered in various transformational programs for process re-engineering, cost optimization, and automation. Gurpreet holds a post-graduation degree in Finance and Merchant Banking. He is a certified underwriter in US mortgage and an agile practitioner.

name: Hari Krishnan
designation: Chief architect and evangelist, Digital Platforms group, Communications, Media and Information Services
bio: Hari Krishnan is a chief architect and evangelist in the Digital Platforms group of TCS' Communications, Media and Information Services business unit. He has over 16 years of experience in the telecommunications domain covering digital architecture and design, new technology assessment and roadmap, and the agile-DevOps way of working. Krishnan has a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University in Hyderabad, India.

name: Hari Shankaran
designation: Mnagement Professional
bio: Hari Shankaran is a management professional with over 20 years of overall experience in the US healthcare provider industry. His primary focus is revenue cycle management (RCM). His experience spans across operations, client management, and project transitions. Hari designs and develops transformation solutions to optimize RCM services and works toward improving the overall patient experience.

name: Hemakiran Gupta
bio: Hemakiran Gupta KURALLA (Kiran) is the Regional Head of TCS Business Unit responsible for Banking, Insurance and Financial Services for mainland Europe. Kiran has worked previously for the State Government in India and subsequently joined TCS in 1993. He went on to play several management roles in the company in India, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, Benelux, and now across Europe

name: Hemlata Jadhwar
bio: Hemlata is a platform architect in the banking technology advisory – focusing on cloud technology for the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. She has over 18 years of experience with a strong focus on cloud technology and has worked with several global banks. She holds a bachelors' degree in Computer Engineering.

name: Hilde Vanaken
designation: Sr. Industry Advisor, TCS Life Sciences and Healthcare
bio: Dr Hilde is a passionate generalist with a track record of turning large & complex concepts into realization through collaboration. She joined TCS in 2019 as a Senior Industry Advisor for TCS Life Sciences & Healthcare having spent the previous +25 years at the pharma side where she shaped & led multiple cross-departmental & cross-pharma preclinical & clinical programs to success stories, e.g. Janssen’s Integrated Smart Trial & Engagement program, Transcelerate eConsent program. Hilde’s current mission is to bring technology and pharma closer together and make the impossible, possible.

name: Himadri Sekhar Paul
designation: Senior Scientist, TCS Research
bio: Himadri is a senior scientist at TCS Research. His domain area focuses on space-based sensing technology. He holds a PhD from IIT-Kharagpur, India, and has 22 patents granted to his credit with over 30 technical contributions published.

name: Himanshu Chaudhary
designation: Consulting Partner, Education Unit, TCS
bio: Himanshu Chaudhary is a Consulting Partner in the Education unit at TCS. He has worked in the professional and higher education space for over a decade. With a striking ability to design solutions and deep domain expertise, Himanshu has served several higher education value chain clients across North America, the UK, Africa, and Australia.

name: Himanshu Deshmukh
designation: Industry Sales Lead, North America, TCS
bio: Himanshu is an industry sales lead, North America at TCS. He has 17 years of experience in research and development, innovation management, business development, and marketing.

name: Hrishikesh Vaishnav
designation: Business Development Manager, Enterprise Architect, TCS BFSI
bio: Hrishikesh (Hrishi) Vaishnav is a Business Development Manager and Enterprise Architect with TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. With over 22 years of industry experience in the data and analytics space, he is currently part of a strategic initiatives group that focuses on the chief data officer function in BFSI firms. In this role, he works with various financial services institutions, helping them become data-driven by establishing an enterprise data foundation, embedding data democratization, and generating value from data assets. He is a TOGAF certified architect and holds a bachelor’s degree in Engineering and a master’s degree in Management studies.

name: Ieva Jankelaityte
bio: Ieva is looking after the talent management and diversity agenda for over 18,000 employees of the UK and Ireland. She is focused on creating a culture of equity, inclusion, and belonging and works in close partnership with business leadership, diverse groups, clients, and the community. She believes that everyone can thrive in the right environment given the right level of support.

name: Imranahmed Petiwala
bio: Imran Petiwala has an extensive experience of over 18 years in Quote to Cash Consulting and delivering large digital transformation programs. In his long career, he has worn the hats of a growth and transformation Strategist/Leader, Salesforce Revenue Cloud & Quote to Cash Practice Lead, Enterprise Architect/Solution Architect, and Delivery Head. He holds a Master’s degree in computers applications from Ganpat University, Gujarat, and is a passionate gardener!

name: Indra Chourasia
designation: Industry Advisor, Analytics and Insights, BFSI, TCS
bio: Indra Chourasia is an Industry Advisor in the Analytics and Insights unit of TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. With 28 years of global experience in business and IT advisory and implementation of transformational projects, he designs digital- and data- led solution offerings and drives thought leadership and client engagements in banking, financial services, and capital markets.

name: Indranil Ghosh
bio: Indranil Ghosh is Chief Architect of Technology & Transformation -Healthcare ISU. He currently leads growth and transformation initiatives for TCS HealthCare Unit focusing on cloud native solutions, DevOps, Intelligent Automation and Micro services architecture. He has over 20 years of experience in designing and developing complex IT solutions in the area of Web and Mobile applications, Application Programming Interface (API), Content Management Systems (CMS), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Digital Asset Management (DAM) architecture, and operations for large hospitals and physicians. He has an MBA from Symbiosis University and has played multiple roles aligned with the healthcare domain.

name: Indranil Ray
bio: Indranil Ray is a senior business consultant with the PLM / ALM transformation division in the North America Automotive and Industrial unit of the Manufacturing Innovation and Transformation Group (ITG) within TCS’ Manufacturing business unit. He has 13 years of experience in automotive product development and business consultancy and advisory services across the manufacturing industry. He holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Operations and Manufacturing Business Management from the S.P. Jain Institute of Management and Research, Mumbai, India, and a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from the Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur, West Bengal, India.

name: Jabeen Anszary
designation: Consultant, Retail Strategic Initiatives, TCS
bio: Jabeen Anszary has over two decades of experience across marketing and retail. She works closely with data scientists, retail consultants, and product owners to craft narratives on the core philosophy driving AI-powered and commerce solutions. With an emphasis on core business challenges, she articulates how TCS helps businesses get better at the basics and build a solid foundation for long-term competitive advantage.

name: Jaison Thekkanath Sebastian
designation: Industry Advisor, Intelligent Products, IoT and Digital Engineering, TCS
bio: Jaison heads the Software Engineering Centre of Excellence for application software within the Intelligent Products Group of IoT and Digital Engineering at TCS. An electronics and communication engineer by training, Jaison has over 26 years of experience in the medical and telecom domains. He has played a pivotal role in various high-impact projects. He has strong medical device system design expertise, as well as software product engineering and medical regulatory experience. He is also driving TCS's software as a medical device initiatives and offerings.

name: James LeMaster
designation: Director, Risk and Cyber Strategy, TCS
bio: James has been helping companies manage their information technology and information security risks, for over 25 years. As an active member and leader of TCS Risk & Cyber Strategy practice in Consulting & Services Integration, he’s supported clients across multiple business sectors with solutions for cyber protection, network engineering, security architecture, policy, risk, compliance and organizational change management. He’s served in roles ranging from analyst/engineer (implementing industry best practices) to director (responsible for developing non-existent business programs from the ground up). James is known for his successful delivery and leadership managing local, national, and international teams.

name: James Olliver
designation: Business Analyst, Consulting & Services Integration, TCS
bio: James Olliver is a Business Analyst in the UK M&A Services team, within TCS' Consulting and Services Integration practice, based in London. He joined TCS in 2022 and is currently working on the demerger of a British multinational company in the life sciences industry. James graduated the University of Bristol in 2021 with an MEng in Engineering Mathematics, completing modules across a range of different fields, including Artificial Intelligence. He has prior experience in manufacturing, finance, and hospitality

name: James Wheless
designation: Global Head of Customer Experience, TCS
bio: Jim serves as the Global Managing Partner, Customer Experience Transformation Services within TCS’s Consulting and Services Integration practice. He has advised numerous Fortune 500 and Mid-Market companies to improve top line revenue growth and increase operating efficiencies leveraging Omni-Channel Customer Experience, Advanced Analytics, and cloud-based Digital & Customer Relationship Management (CRM) technologies. Recent client engagements include Philips Domestic Appliance, DuPont, Takeda, and Thomson Reuters among others. Prior to TCS, Jim held leadership roles at Accenture building their Digital Practice (Interactive and Analytics) and expanding their global CRM practice where he led the market and offering development of a full suite of capabilities across customer experience, advanced analytics and AI, digital marketing, and CRM solutions.

name: Janardhan Santhanam
designation: TCS Lead, Analytics, Big Data, and Information Management, Retail and CPG
bio: TCS Talent Development Head Janardhan Santhanam has over 22 years of industry experience across the Retail, Consumer Goods and Manufacturing industries. He is responsible for the growth and transformation process of TCS Talent -- from fresh recruits to senior leadership. Janardhan has a sound grasp of skill sets and traits needed across technologies, domains and processes, especially in the context of Business 4.0TM. He has performed key roles like consulting, program management, client relationship and delivery partnership with global enterprises. Janardhan holds a Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering. He likes long walks, gardening, and enjoys listening to podcasts.

name: Jan Erik Johannson
designation: Industry Advisor
bio: Jan has over 35 years of oil and gas upstream experience encompassing field operations, operations management with regional responsibility, software development, startup operations, marketing, and consulting. His career has spanned the globe from Asia through Europe, South America and now North America and Canada. Johansson’s current focus is on OSDU, energy transition, asset inspection and integration of new skills into asset teams in the upstream oil and gas industry. He is also the lead for the upstream oil and gas in the Americas Business Unit He has contributed multiple blogs to industry publications and white papers, and has been a panelist at multiple conferences including MIT, ARC Advisory Groups Annual conference and client customer events. Johansson has an engineering degree in electronics with transmission technology specialty from Polhelms Technical Gymnasium in Sweden. He is an active member of Society of Petroleum Engineers, American Association of Petroleum Geologists, Society of Exploration Geophysicists and American Society of Mechanical Engineers.

name: Jayant Dani
designation: Privacy Lead Assessor, TCS
bio: Jayant is an Open Group Certified Master Architect and Data Security Council of India (DSCI) certified Privacy Lead Assessor at TCS. Jayant is passionate about architecting technology solutions across industry verticals. He architected TCS proprietary integrated data management platform, TCS MasterCraft™ DataPlus. Also, he played leading role in setting up the Big Data practice in TCS. He has over 24 years of experience, and his area of expertise includes technical leadership of large solution teams, client relationships and management of large-scale implementations.

name: Dr Jayasheela Rajashekhar (Jay)
designation: PV lead and domain consultant, Life sciences, TCS
bio: He has led PV operations and transformations in multiple geographies and regions (including LATAM, Japan and Asian countries) and has been instrumental in setting up local safety operations and LPPV offices. He has led and participated in successful regulatory inspections (US-FDA, MHRA, EMA, BfArM, TGA, and other regional regulatory), and has also been a pharmacovigilance expert. He has been involved in global PV transitions and works as a PV domain consultant and industry leader at TCS.

name: Jayashree Arunkumar
bio: Jayashree Arunkumar is a technical architect working with the Incubation unit within Research and Innovation. She has significant experience in IT service management, network management, operations automation, and more recently, model operations. Her focus areas are identifying and developing new offerings to drive innovation.

name: Jay Gupta
designation: Product Management Specialist, TCS Digital Software & Solutions
bio: With over 16 years of experience in product development and management primarily for the Telecom and Energy industry, Jay Gupta is involved in IoT, cloud, remote monitoring, machine-to-machine communication, and data analytics and AI at TCS Digital Software & Solutions.

name: Jayita Dutta
designation: Researcher, TCS Research
bio: Venkat heads TCS Financial Solutions, a strategic business unit of TCS. Over the last 27 years, Venkat has performed a variety of roles in the financial services and financial software products business, including product strategy, program management, sales, customer relationship and key account management. In his current role, he is responsible for leading the packaged software products business for financial services, globally, under the brand name, TCS BaNCS.

name: Jay Rabheru
bio: Jay Rabheru is the director of marketing technology for TCS commercial life sciences and has over 13 years of pharma industry experience. Jay works with clients to create market-leading digital marketing and commercial strategies that deliver value for patients. He is a technology enthusiast and a commercial transformation leader. Jay, who has studied law in London, has completed Microsoft Certified Application Developer (MCAD), Microsoft Certified Technology Specialist (MCTS) and Microsoft Certified Solution Developer (MCSD).

name: Jegan Fernando
designation: ANZ LATAM Industry Advisory Head and Chief Architect for TCS Contexify™ CMI, TCS
bio: Jegan Fernando heads the Industry Advisory Group for Australia, New Zealand and LATAM, CMI, TCS and is the chief architect for TCS Contexify™. He has over 25 years of experience in consulting and architecting various transformational initiatives across the globe. He drives various digital and technological transformation initiatives across organizations through thought leadership. He is a telecom domain expert specialized in B/OSS, contact center and network platforms. He holds a bachelor’s degree from College of Engineering, Guindy, Chennai.

name: Jenamani Barnali Bhardwaj
designation: Analyst, Software and Services
bio: J Barnali Bharadwaj is a functional analyst with the Software and Services segment. She specializes in sustainability and human capital management and has been part of several large-scale digital transformation engagements powered by artificial intelligence, machine learning, and blockchain. Barnali is a thought leader and has shepherded several growth and transformation initiatives for TCS’ clients.

name: Jm Kumar
designation: Senior Consultant, Finance and Reporting practice, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, TCS
bio: Jm Kumar is a Senior Business Consultant with TCS’ Banking and Financial Services unit and has over 10 years of experience in the finance, reporting, and compliance space. Kumar holds an MBA degree in Finance from the Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Higher Learning, Andhra Pradesh, India, and is a Certified Associate of the Indian Institute of Bankers.

name: Joann Evangelista
designation: Head of US Patient Safety Operations & Innovations Genentech, Member of the Roche Group
bio: Joann is the Head of US Patient Safety Operations & Innovations at Genentech, with over 20 years of experience in a federally regulated landscape holding multiple positions in the Commercial and Medical Affairs organizations. She is a revered visionary leader and integrated systems thinker whose journey with Artificial Intelligence started seven years ago when AI in AE detection was at the edge of its adoption. She has cultivated an environment rich in technology using innovative approaches with AI and machine learning to sustain PV operational excellence in a rapidly changing environment. Joann’s experiences and perspective have lent itself to assess multiple AI tools across high risk PV areas to decrease exposure and increase compliance and efficiency.

name: Joe DiPrima
designation: Chief Information Officer, Cordis Corporation
bio: Joe DiPrima is Chief Information Officer at Cordis Corporation. He is currently leading Cordis through its stand-up as an independent business from a recent divestiture. He has extensive experience as a leader across medical devices technology, information technology, business consulting services, and defense contracting industries. He also has a proven record of success in project and portfolio management and management consulting.

name: John O’Leary
designation: Corporate Communications Manager, TCS North America
bio: John specializes in trending technologies and the market forces shaping the changing face of business. With experience working at several award-winning public relations firms representing both fast-growing startups and some of the world’s largest technology companies, John is passionate about connecting the dots between what businesses are doing and what people need to tell stories of innovation and inspiration. As an optimist when it comes to the potential of technology to change the world for long-lasting, positive impact, he works with TCS’ futurists and senior executives to uncover hidden insights and put a spotlight on the infrastructure and experts who are creating the building blocks that will transform how we work, how we live, and how we think.

name: Jonathan Iggulden
designation: Business Consultant, Consulting & Services Integration, TCS
bio: Mergers and Acquisitions specialist Jonathan Iggulden studied Astrophysics at university before going on to be a quantitative analyst for a Swiss Private Equity firm. In this capacity, he supported some of the largest company deals ever made and analysed the rationale behind some of the most technical venture investments in the world. From there he moved to the City of London, where he advised Fund Managers on portfolio construction and fund company analysis. A mountaineer and Fellow of the Royal Geographical Society, Jonathan has founded a business in Chilean Patagonia and now lives in London and leverages his experience of planning, strategy and analysis from business and climbing for the benefit of TCS clients globally.

name: Joyce E Johnson
designation: Ordinary Professor at The Catholic University of America, Conway School of Nursing
bio: As an ordinary professor at The Catholic University of America, Conway School of Nursing, Dr Joyce E Johnson’s primary teaching focus is graduate-level writing and publication, policy analysis and formation, leadership in complex healthcare systems, healthcare finance, and dissertation and evidence-based practice project development. Her publications include several academic textbooks focusing on executive leadership, graduate-level scholarly writing, and business plan development. For 13 years, Dr Johnson founded and published Nursing Connections, the first nationally refereed scholarly journal published from a practice setting.

name: J Ramkumar
bio: Ramkumar is part of the Education business unit at TCS. He has over 23 years of corporate experience and has held various product and business roles in organizations such as Reliance Industries and State Bank of India prior to joining TCS. He has deep expertise in business, product strategy, and deployment. He also has extensive experience in managing large and strategic engagements. Prior to the current role, he led the higher education segment for TCS iON TM .

name: Julie Wang
designation: Director Consultant, TCS
bio: Julie Wang is a director in consulting at TCS. She is an M&A strategy and corporate finance professional with 18 years of experience in management consulting, deal management, and FP&A. She has advised large Fortune 500 clients on integration and separation pre-deal and post close. She has led numerous large corporate initiatives and complex cross-functional M&A engagements. Her expertise has been in supporting corporate finance leaders in target state designing, synergy realization, cost optimization, and organization transformation. Julie obtained her MBA from UCLA Anderson School of Business, and she graduated with dual bachelorette degrees from the University of Maryland, College Park. In her spare time, she enjoys yoga and spending time with her family.

name: Jyoti Joshi
designation: Engineering Lead, TCS MasterCraft™ TransformPlus
bio: Jyoti Joshi is Engineering Lead of TCS MasterCraft™ TransformPlus Forward Engineering Edition, the digital application development platform. With over 18 years of experience in IT, Joshi played a key role in various project and product development assignments. Her expertise includes managing large implementations and technical solutions. She is TOGAF certified enterprise architect. Joshi holds a Bachelors of Engineering Degree in Computer Science and Engineering from Govt. College of Engineering, Aurangabad.

name: Kala Desai
bio: As a banking and mortgage domain practitioner, Kala has over 20 years of diverse experience across banking, mortgage operations, and consulting services. She has spent most part of her career working with clients to complete the digital and operational maturity assessment of their mortgage business and partner with them to execute transformational programs underpinned by technology as per their budget, goals, and plan. Kala holds a post-graduation diploma in business management. She is also a certified PMP consultant and a certified agile coach.

name: Kallol Basu
designation: Head - Strategy, Communications, Media, and Information Services
bio: Kallol Basu is a senior consultant who works on business development, change management, and transformation programs under the communications and media vertical in TCS. With a PhD in Business Transformation from Kedge Business School, Marseille, Kallol is a key member of several industry bodies and non-profit organizations.

name: Kalpana Palaniappan
designation: Domain Consultant, Banking, Financial Services and Insurance, TCS
bio: Kalpana Palaniappan is a domain consultant with TCS' Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. She has over 20 years of experience in mortgage consulting and domain support for business transformation initiatives. In her current role, Kalpana helps build organization-wide capabilities in the lending domain. She is an IIBA-certified business analyst and US mortgage underwriter.

name: Kamal Bhadada
designation: President and Global Head, TCS Interactive
bio: Kamal Bhadada is the president of TCS Interactive. Additionally, Kamal leads the TCS HOBS TM and TCS TwinX TM product platform businesses. During his more than 30 years in the technology industry, Kamal has worked in diverse leadership roles and built new businesses across industries. He has served on the TM Forum’s Beyond Connectivity Advisory Board and as a business advisor and an innovation enabler for some of the world’s leading companies.

name: Kamesh Chelluri
bio: Kamesh leads the Next-Gen Advisory Services group within TCS' Communications, Media and Information Services business unit. He brings over two decades of global experience working with Fortune 500 companies and startups, developing digital transformation strategies for TCS’ clients.

name: Kamesh Meduri
designation: Enterprise Architect, Insurance Transformation Group, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, TCS
bio: Kamesh Meduri is Chief Architect with TCS Banking and Financial Services (Central Europe) unit and has over 20 years of experience in the insurance and retail banking domains. Kamesh holds a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering and a master’s degree in Economics from BITS - Pilani, India. He is Certified TOGAF architect and Guidewire InsuranceSuite Integration Specialist.

name: Kamini Bhargava
designation: Chief Architect, Transformation and Engineering Group, Healthcare, TCS
bio: Kamini Bhargava is Chief Architect, Transformation and Engineering Group, Healthcare, TCS. She has 22+ years of industry experience in technology, solutions, and consulting. She has a vast experience in Banking and Finance (BFS), Insurance, Healthcare, and technology, and domain-focused solutioning for various customers in the US and Europe. She conceptualizes strategic solutions and platforms for healthcare customers including payers, integrated payer-providers, specialty providers, and Pharmacy Benefit Management companies. With a vast experience in executing large-scale transformational programs, she is also an expert in Microsoft technology, integration, DevOps, and Agile.

name: Karthik Dhinakara Ram
designation: Lead, Capital Markets Industry Advisory, BFSI, TCS
bio: Karthik Dhinakara Ram leads the Capital Markets Industry Advisory Group in TCS’ Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He has over 25 years of experience in delivering consulting, solution development, and program management engagements to buy-side, sell-side, and market infrastructure firms. He has also been involved in large transformations for TCS’ clients across North America, Europe, LATAM, and Asia.

name: Karthikeyan Rengasamy
bio: Karthikeyan Rengasamy is a Chief Architect for TCS Banking and Financial Services unit with over 19 years of experience in IT Architecture Solution Design. His skillset cuts across the technology platforms from legacy to cloud and beyond. Karthikeyan holds a Masters’ degree in Business Administration and a Bachelors’ in Electronics and Communication Engineering.

name: Karthikeyan Sabesan
designation: Lead, COE for Edge Computing, CBO, TCS
bio: Karthikeyan Sabesan is the lead for the Edge Computing Center of Excellence (COE) within the Enterprise CBO business unit at TCS. As a business consultant with more than 16 years of consulting experience, he has worked closely with leading companies across the globe, helping them use the power of technology and the latest technology innovations to solve complex business problems and drive greater outcomes for their organizations. He is currently focused on generative AI initiatives that can accelerate business transformation.

name: Karthik Rajamani
designation: Product Manager
bio: Currently a Product Manager for TCS Analytics & Insights, Karthik Rajamani has donned various hats in the last 15 plus years in the IT industry. He’s been a Developer, Technical Lead, Lead Support Engineer, Project Manager, IT Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Data Engineer, Citizen Data Scientist, Product Evangelist, Tools Admin to name a few. A B.Tech in IT, Karthik has worked across Public Services, Hi-Tech, Life Sciences, Health Care, and BFSI industry verticals. He loves reading, learning new languages as well as learning about different cultures, and working with people to bring a multi-dimensional view to a problem. He believes in providing simple solutions, keeping the end-user in mind.

name: Katherine Burger
designation: Practice Lead, Insurance , TCS
bio: Katherine Burger is a Practice Lead with the Insurance and Healthcare unit at Tata Consultancy Services. She is a thought leader and communicator in the area of business technology, with a particular focus on analyzing the ways technology enables financial services organizations to be more productive, competitive and profitable. She served as Editorial Director of Insurance & Technology from 1991-2015 and Bank Systems & Technology from 2003-2015. At I&T and BS&T, in addition to directing the editorial strategy of both brands, Kathy handled both digital- and print-medium publications, spanning from new products and editorial supplements to live and online events, including summits, forums, webinars and roundtables. Kathy has been a frequent speaker and/or moderator at financial services industry conferences, and also has presented at a number of technology company user group and sales force events. She is a graduate of Carleton College.

name: Kathleen Holm
designation: Marketing Director, TCS Digital Software & Solutions
bio: Kathleen Holm is Marketing Director of the TCS Digital Software & Solutions (DS&S) Group. She has more than 25 years of experience marketing technology software and services to enterprises worldwide. She leverages her extensive background in enterprise software technology to help organizations develop effective marketing strategies, create targeted messaging and positioning, and implement effective go-to-market plans to improve corporate performance. Prior to joining TCS, Kathleen was a Senior Principal of technical product marketing for Oracle Fusion Middleware where she was responsible for defining the marketing strategy based on industry maturity and customer trends. She also held positions at IBM including Market Manager for WebSphere Developer Programs, Market Manager for Tivoli Integrated Service Management and Tivoli Brand Specialist. Prior to joining IBM, Kathleen worked with four high-tech startups.

name: Kausik Mukherjee
designation: Enterprise Architect, Energy Resource Unit, TCS-India
bio: Kausik is an IT strategy and transformation consultant with over 24 years of experience across areas such as systems software support, systems integration solution conceptualization, and IT consulting. He currently works as a solution lead to drive technology-led business transformation across the energy, resources, and infrastructure sectors for customers in India and the Middle East and Africa region. Kausik also plays a lead architect role in driving large opportunities and has been part of the global consulting practice to drive and fulfill IT strategy and architecture consulting for global customers.

name: Kelly Foree
designation: Consulting Partner, Retail, TCS
bio: Kelly Foree, a consultant with TCS’ Retail unit, holds a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology from the University of Michigan. Her key skills include long-range planning, developing high-performing teams, building cross-functional relationships, strategic organizational development, sales driver, inventory management, supply planning, marketing strategy, and price optimization. She also helps retail enterprises with her expertise in process management, direct-to-consumer marketing and merchandising, data and analytics, C-suite presentations, strategy planning and execution, cost reduction, and master data management.

name: Kishore Kumar MK
bio: Kishore Kumar MK is a consultant with the HiTech business unit of TCS. He has over 17 years of IT experience and has delivered on key IT projects across telecom, retail, and the high tech domains. His areas of interest include business intelligence, digital marketing, and data analytics. He holds a master’s degree in electrical engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee, India.

name: Kostas Kidos
designation: VP, Head of Global Patient Safety Operations at Takeda
bio: Kostas Kidos is Takeda's vice president and head of global patient safety operations. His innovations include paperless ICSR workflows, PV ICH standards, and signal detection tools and processes. Using AI algorithms for causality assessments, predictive signal detection, and AI-driven decision support, he has also developed and implemented innovative solutions in collaboration with academia.

name: Kottai A
bio: Kottai A leads data integration and analytics at TCS’ AWS business unit. He has more than 27 years of IT industry experience with extensive expertise in product CoEs, services delivery, customer success, consulting, sales, partners GTM, program and stakeholder management. His areas of expertise include cloud, data, analytics, digital transformation, enterprise applications, information management, workplace innovation, e-commerce, martech and edtech.

name: Koushik Pal
bio: Koushik leads solution conceptualization and development for the Information Services business unit at TCS and focuses on enabling smooth delivery of services to TCS customers. His passion is to challenge, reimagine the existing business models, and create new ones by leveraging new technologies and the vast ecosystem of TCS. His close association with the IT industry spans almost two decades where he has worked across delivery and business relationship management. He is also involved in developing forward-looking strategies and key offerings for information services companies.

name: K Ramamoorthy
designation: Head, Insurance Industry Advisory Group, Banking, Financial Services and Insurance, TCS
bio: K Ramamoorthy heads the Insurance Industry Advisory Group (IAG) in the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit at TCS. He has over 28 years of experience in consulting, solution development, and program management for insurance companies. K Ramamoorthy heads the Insurance Industry Advisory Group (IAG) in the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit at TCS. He has over 28 years of experience in consulting, solution development, and program management for insurance companies. He has been involved in programs aimed at digital transformation, business function reimagination, operational efficiency optimization, and legacy debt management for clients across North America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

name: Kripa Subramanian
designation: Sustainability Lead, TCS
bio: Kripa, a sustainability leader and industry partner to customers of TCS, has gained more than two decades of experience in data and sustainability. She is a senior leader with deep functional expertise in strategic planning, advisory, digital, and business transformation. Passionate about making a positive impact on the environment and promoting sustainable practices within organizations, she believes sustainability is not purely an environmental issue but a business and economic one as well. She is committed to working with organizations to shape a more sustainable future by integrating sustainability into core business strategies and operations.

name: Krishnan Ramanujam​
designation: President, Consumer Business Group, TCS
bio: Krishnan Ramanujam is the President of Tata Consultancy Services’ Consumer Business Group. He is responsible for driving the vision and strategy for the unit, which works with the world’s leading companies across retail, consumer goods, distribution, travel, and logistics. Krishnan focuses on making technology work for enterprises in pursuit of their biggest opportunities. He helps organizations gain a tech-powered competitive advantage—from offering a delightful customer experience to building agile supply chains to reimagining business models. Krishnan and his team combine their deep industry experience, technology expertise, and understanding of client organizations to guide complex technology-led transformations that improve efficiencies and drive growth. Over the three decades of his TCS career, Krishnan has held many senior leadership roles that spanned across technology service lines, consulting practices, enterprise application solutions, and more. In his previous role, he led and grew TCS’ horizontal organization across services, including cloud, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, IoT, and data analytics. Krishnan has a BS and an MS in engineering and lives in Mumbai, India. He was the 2023 Chairperson of Nasscom, the premier trade association and chamber of commerce for India’s technology industry. He is passionate about promoting education in rural communities in India. Outside of work, he enjoys spending time with his family, learning Japanese, and reading non-fiction books.

name: Krishna Priya V K
designation: Associate Consultant, TCS ADD™
bio: Krishnapriya has been working in the field of big data implementation, data warehouse, and ETL tools for the last 15 years. She has played key roles in multiple system integration programs, migration programs, as well as modernization programs.

name: Krithivasan S
designation: Lead, Supply chain management, Europe, MFG, TCS
bio: Krithivasan S is a Lead for the supply chain management business consulting practice for Europe, Manufacturing at TCS. Krithi has more than two decades of experience across manufacturing, retail, and telecom. He consults customers on strategy formulation, roadmap definition, and business process improvements. He has wide experience in managing large business transformation programs for customers globally.

name: Kritika Abrol
designation: Senior engineer (Cloud technology solutions and machine learning)
bio: Kritika Abrol is a senior engineer with TCS Platform Solutions. She has 10 years of experience in cloud technology solutions and Machine Learning (ML). Her expertise includes solution design, development, and implementation of various cloud technology solutions and ML use cases. She has seen the technical implementation of several cloud projects while directing all aspects of the project lifecycle. In her current role, she oversees developing and deploying state-of-the-art architectural and infrastructural solutions and features for an ITOps platform. She holds a bachelor's in electronics and telecommunications from Amity University, Noida, India.

name: Kshitiz Mittal
designation: Regional Head of Sales, TCS BaNCS
bio: Kshitiz Mittal is passionate about helping organizations automate front-middle-back office functions using functionally rich and technically advanced products from TCS BaNCS. He is currently the Regional Head of Sales for TCS BaNCS in North America and has spent 22 years working with custodians, asset managers and brokers. He has also managed various large transformation programs helping reduce risk and increase automation in securities processing. Besides technology, his other areas of interest include business strategy, personal finance, and human psychology. Kshitiz has a degree in computer engineering, is PMP-certified, and an MBA in Strategy and Finance from UNC, Chapel Hill.

name: Kuldeep Pandita
designation: Geo Lead, Education Business Unit, ANZ
bio: Kuldeep leads education business for TCS in Australia & New Zealand. He has over 22 years of experience in digital transformation. Kuldeep has been a trusted advisor to CXO’s and has led large scale transformations. He is responsible for business strategy, sales, capability development and partnerships in education sector for Australia and New Zealand. He is certified in digital transformation from University of California, Berkeley, Haas School of Business.

name: Kuldeep Shrimali
designation: Consulting Partner, Capital Markets Banking, BFSI, TCS
bio: Kuldeep is a consulting partner with the Capital Markets group of TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He has over 22 years of consulting experience in the capital markets space. Kuldeep has worked with leading global financial firms across geographies and successfully executed several strategic technology transformation programs in the areas of wealth management and capital markets.

name: Kulwinder Gill
bio: Kulwinder Gill has over 20 years of experience in marketing technology for Banks, Financial Services and Insurance industries. She helps marketing leaders make a greater impact on customers and drive growth through marketing and technology innovation. She has strong skills in strategy, planning, communication, digital and marketing technology, and works with global brands.

name: Kumar Siddharth
bio: Kumar Siddharth is a solution architect with TCS’ Cyber Security business unit’s center of excellence for IoT and ICS-OT security. He was instrumental in setting up IoT device security testing lab for delivering services to TCS customers. Siddharth has 16 years of experience in the IT industry and has previously handled various roles in the area of enterprise vulnerability management, penetration testing, ethical hacking, and enterprise risk and compliance.

name: K Vaidyanathan
designation: Consultant, Multi cloud advisory, TCS
bio: K. Vaidyanathan is a multi-cloud advisory consultant in mainframe optimization, enterprise IT architecture, and cloud strategy. He has led multiple engagements in defining strategy and executing large modernization programs across financial services, retail, life sciences, hi-tech and manufacturing. He is a certified cloud architect across multiple hyper scaler cloud platform solutions and technologies.

name: Lakshmi Priya Das
designation: Domain Consultant, BFSI, TCS
bio: Lakshmi Priya Das is a Functional Consultant with the Banking and Financial Services (BFS) business unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). A subject matter expert on mortgage business, she worked with a leading mortgage servicing organization before joining TCS. With over four years of experience in TCS, Lakshmi has built significant expertise in the US retail mortgage market and has worked on strategic consulting assignments for TCS leading clients.

name: Lekha Menon
designation: Infrastructure Practice Lead - Cognitive Business Operations
bio: Lekha is an Enterprise Architect with more than 25 years of IT experience and currently handles the role of Infrastructure Practice lead in the Cognitive Business Operations group at TCS. She has handled several roles that ranged from strategy consulting engagement lead, defining solution architecture, leading presales for large and transformational deals to solution offering development. She is currently leading infrastructure transformation for customers focused on agility, resilience, and sustainability.
